DetailedAnswer: (vi) $I=\int\frac{dx}{3\sin x+2\cos x+5}$\\$=\int\frac{(1+\tan^2\frac{x}{2})\,dx}{6\tan\frac{x}{2}+2(1-\tan^2\frac{x}{2})+5(1+\tan^2\frac{x}{2})}$\\$=\int\frac{\sec^2\frac{x}{2}\,dx}{3\tan^2\frac{x}{2}+6\tan\frac{x}{2}+7}=\frac{2}{3}\int\frac{d(\tan\frac{x}{2})}{(\tan\frac{x}{2}+1)^2+\left(\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\right)^2}$\\$=\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\tan^{-1}\left\{\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\left(\tan\frac{x}{2}+1\right)\right\}+c$।

Question: বিগত বছরের ইঞ্জিনিয়ারিং ও বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় ভর্তি পরীক্ষার লিখিত প্রশ্ন. 12. $\int\frac{dx}{\sqrt{x}+\sqrt{1-x}}$ এর মান বের কর।
DetailedAnswer: 12. $\int\frac{dx}{\sqrt{x}+\sqrt{1-x}}=\int\frac{\sqrt{x}-\sqrt{1-x}}{x-1+x}\,dx$\\$=\int\frac{\sqrt{x}}{2x-1}\,dx-\int\frac{\sqrt{1-x}}{2x-1}\,dx$\\প্রথমটির জন্য $x=z^2$, $dx=2z\,dz$ এবং দ্বিতীয়টির জন্য $1-x=u^2$, $dx=-2u\,du$।\\$=\int\frac{2z^2\,dz}{2z^2-1}-\int\frac{2u^2\,du}{2u^2-1}$\\$=z+\frac{1}{2\sqrt{2}}\ln\left|\frac{\sqrt{2z}-1}{\sqrt{2z}+1}\right|-u-\frac{1}{2\sqrt{2}}\ln\left|\frac{\sqrt{2u}-1}{\sqrt{2u}+1}\right|+c$\\$=\sqrt{x}+\frac{1}{2\sqrt{2}}\ln\left|\frac{\sqrt{2x}-1}{\sqrt{2x}+1}\right|-\sqrt{1-x}-\frac{1}{2\sqrt{2}}\ln\left|\frac{\sqrt{2-2x}-1}{\sqrt{2-2x}+1}\right|+c$।

Question: বিগত বছরের ইঞ্জিনিয়ারিং ও বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় ভর্তি পরীক্ষার লিখিত প্রশ্ন. 13. মান নির্ণয় কর: $\int(\sqrt{\tan x}+\sqrt{\cot x})dx$
DetailedAnswer: 13. $\int(\sqrt{\tan x}+\sqrt{\cot x})\,dx$\\$=\int\left(\sqrt{\frac{\sin x}{\cos x}}+\sqrt{\frac{\cos x}{\sin x}}\right)dx=\int\frac{\sin x+\cos x}{\sqrt{\sin x\cos x}}\,dx$\\$=\sqrt{2}\int\frac{\sin x+\cos x}{\sqrt{2\sin x\cos x}}\,dx=\sqrt{2}\int\frac{d(\sin x-\cos x)}{\sqrt{1-(\sin x-\cos x)^2}}$\\$=\sqrt{2}\sin^{-1}(\sin x-\cos x)+c$।

Question: বিগত বছরের ইঞ্জিনিয়ারিং ও বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় ভর্তি পরীক্ষার লিখিত প্রশ্ন. 14. মান নির্ণয় কর: $\int\frac{dx}{(x^2+9)^2}$
DetailedAnswer: 14. ধরি, $x=3\tan\theta$, তাহলে $dx=3\sec^2\theta\,d\theta$।\\$\int\frac{dx}{(x^2+9)^2}=\int\frac{3\sec^2\theta\,d\theta}{(9\tan^2\theta+9)^2}$\\$=\frac{1}{27}\int\cos^2\theta\,d\theta=\frac{1}{54}\int(1+\cos2\theta)\,d\theta$\\$=\frac{1}{54}\left(\theta+\frac{1}{2}\sin2\theta\right)+c$\\$=\frac{1}{54}\left(\tan^{-1}\frac{x}{3}+\frac{3x}{9+x^2}\right)+c$।

Question: বিগত বছরের ইঞ্জিনিয়ারিং ও বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় ভর্তি পরীক্ষার লিখিত প্রশ্ন. 15. মান নির্ণয় কর: $\int\frac{adx}{\sqrt{(x^2+a^2)^3}}$
DetailedAnswer: 15. ধরি, $x=a\tan\theta$, তাহলে $dx=a\sec^2\theta\,d\theta$।\\$\int\frac{a\,dx}{\sqrt{(x^2+a^2)^3}}=\int\frac{a^2\sec^2\theta\,d\theta}{a^3\sec^3\theta}$\\$=\frac{1}{a}\int\cos\theta\,d\theta=\frac{1}{a}\sin\theta+c$\\$=\frac{1}{a}\sin\left[\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{x}{a}\right)\right]+c$।

Question: $\int\frac{dx}{x^2+x-6}$
DetailedAnswer: (i) $\frac{1}{x^2+x-6}=\frac{1}{(x+3)(x-2)}=\frac{-1}{5(x+3)}+\frac{1}{5(x-2)}$ [By cover-up rule]\\$\therefore \int\frac{dx}{x^2+x-6}=\int\left\{\frac{-1}{5(x+3)}+\frac{1}{5(x-2)}\right\}dx$\\$=-\frac{1}{5}\ln(x+3)+\frac{1}{5}\ln(x-2)+c=\frac{1}{5}\ln\left|\frac{x-2}{x+3}\right|+c$।

Question: $\int\frac{x+1}{3x^2-x-2}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (ii) $\frac{x+1}{3x^2-x-2}=\frac{x+1}{(3x+2)(x-1)}$\\$=\frac{2}{5(x-1)}-\frac{1}{5(3x+2)}$ [By cover-up rule]\\$\therefore \int\frac{x+1}{3x^2-x-2}\,dx=\frac{2}{5}\int\frac{dx}{x-1}-\frac{1}{5}\int\frac{dx}{3x+2}$\\$=\frac{2}{5}\ln|x-1|-\frac{1}{15}\ln|3x+2|+c$।

Question: $\int\frac{dx}{x(x-1)(x-3)}$
DetailedAnswer: (iii) $\frac{1}{x(x-1)(x-3)}=\frac{1}{3x}-\frac{1}{2(x-1)}+\frac{1}{6(x-3)}$ [By cover-up rule]\\$\therefore \int\frac{dx}{x(x-1)(x-3)}=\frac{1}{3}\int\frac{dx}{x}-\frac{1}{2}\int\frac{dx}{x-1}+\frac{1}{6}\int\frac{dx}{x-3}$\\$=\frac{1}{3}\ln|x|-\frac{1}{2}\ln|x-1|+\frac{1}{6}\ln|x-3|+c$।

Question: $\int\frac{x-3}{(1-2x)(1+x)}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (iv) $\frac{x-3}{(1-2x)(1+x)}=\frac{-5}{3(1-2x)}-\frac{4}{3(1+x)}$ [By cover-up rule]\\$\therefore \int\frac{x-3}{(1-2x)(1+x)}\,dx=-\frac{5}{3}\int\frac{dx}{1-2x}-\frac{4}{3}\int\frac{dx}{1+x}$\\$=\frac{5}{6}\ln|1-2x|-\frac{4}{3}\ln|1+x|+c$।

Question: $\int\frac{2x+3}{x^3+x^2-2x}dx$
$\int\frac{x+35}{x^2-25}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (vi) $\frac{x+35}{x^2-25}=\frac{x+35}{(x+5)(x-5)}=\frac{4}{x-5}-\frac{3}{x+5}$ [By cover-up rule]\\$\therefore \int\frac{x+35}{x^2-25}\,dx=4\int\frac{dx}{x-5}-3\int\frac{dx}{x+5}$\\$=4\ln|x-5|-3\ln|x+5|+c$।

Question: $\int\frac{x^3-2x+3}{x^2+x-2}dx$
$\int\frac{x^2-1}{x^2-4}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (i) $\frac{x^2-1}{x^2-4}=1+\frac{3}{x^2-4}=1-\frac{3}{4(x+2)}+\frac{3}{4(x-2)}$।\\$\therefore \int\frac{x^2-1}{x^2-4}\,dx=\int dx-\frac{3}{4}\int\frac{dx}{x+2}+\frac{3}{4}\int\frac{dx}{x-2}$\\$=x-\frac{3}{4}\ln(x+2)+\frac{3}{4}\ln(x-2)+c=x+\frac{3}{4}\ln\left|\frac{x-2}{x+2}\right|+c$।

Question: $\int\frac{x^2}{x^2-4}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (ii) $\int\frac{x^2}{x^2-4}\,dx=\int\frac{(x^2-4)+4}{x^2-4}\,dx$\\$=\int dx+4\int\frac{dx}{x^2-2^2}$\\$=x+\ln\left|\frac{x-2}{x+2}\right|+c$।

Question: $\int\frac{dx}{(e^x-1)(e^x+3)}$
DetailedAnswer: (iii) মনে করি, $\frac{1}{(e^x-1)(e^x+3)}=\frac{A}{e^x-1}+\frac{B}{e^x+3}$।\\উত্তর পক্ষকে $(e^x-1)(e^x+3)$ দ্বারা গুণ করে $A=\frac{1}{4},\;B=-\frac{1}{4}$ পাই।\\$\therefore \int\frac{dx}{(e^x-1)(e^x+3)}=\frac{1}{4}\int\left(\frac{1}{e^x-1}-\frac{1}{e^x+3}\right)dx$\\$=-\frac{1}{3}\ln|e^x|+\frac{1}{4}\ln|e^x-1|+\frac{1}{12}\ln|e^x+3|+c$।

Question: Type-II. 3.(i) $\int\frac{1}{x(x+1)^2}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (i) $\frac{1}{x(x+1)^2}=\frac{1}{x}-\frac{1}{x+1}-\frac{1}{(x+1)^2}$ [By cover-up rule]\\$\therefore \int\frac{1}{x(x+1)^2}\,dx=\int\frac{dx}{x}-\int\frac{dx}{x+1}-\int\frac{dx}{(x+1)^2}$\\$=\ln x-\ln(x+1)+\frac{1}{x+1}+c=\ln\left|\frac{x}{x+1}\right|+\frac{1}{x+1}+c$।

Question: Type-II. 3.(ii) $\int\frac{dx}{x^2(x-1)}$
DetailedAnswer: (ii) $\frac{1}{x^2(x-1)}=\frac{1}{x-1}-\frac{1}{x}-\frac{1}{x^2}$ [By cover-up rule]\\$\therefore \int\frac{dx}{x^2(x-1)}=\int\left(\frac{1}{x-1}-\frac{1}{x}-\frac{1}{x^2}\right)dx$\\$=\ln|x-1|-\ln x+x^{-1}+c=\ln\left|\frac{x-1}{x}\right|+\frac{1}{x}+c$।

Question: Type-II. 3.(iii) $\int\frac{2x+1}{(x+2)(x-3)^2}dx$
Type-II. 3.(iv) $\int\frac{x}{(x+1)^2(x+2)}dx$
Type-II. 3.(vi) $\int\frac{x^2+1}{(x+2)^2}dx$
Type-II. 3.(vii) $\int\frac{dx}{x^2(x+1)^2}$
DetailedAnswer: (vii) মনে করি, $\frac{1}{x^2(x+1)^2}=\frac{A}{x}+\frac{B}{x^2}+\frac{C}{x+1}+\frac{D}{(x+1)^2}$।\\সহগ তুলনা করে $B=1,\;D=1,\;A=-2,\;C=2$।\\$\therefore \int\frac{dx}{x^2(x+1)^2}=-2\int\frac{dx}{x}+\int\frac{dx}{x^2}+2\int\frac{dx}{x+1}+\int\frac{dx}{(1+x)^2}$\\$=-\frac{1}{x}-2\ln|x|+2\ln|x+1|-\frac{1}{1+x}+c$।

Question: Type-II. 3.(viii) $\int\frac{x}{(x-4)^2(x-3)}dx$
Type-II. 3.(ix) $\int\frac{x^7}{(1-x^4)^2}dx$
Type-II. 3.(x) $\int\frac{(x-2)^2}{(x+1)^2}dx$
$\int\frac{xdx}{(x-1)(x^2+4)}$
$\int\frac{2x^2}{(x^2+1)(x^2+3)}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (ii) ধরি, $y=x^2$ এবং $\frac{2y}{(y+1)(y+3)}=\frac{A}{y+1}+\frac{B}{y+3}$।\\মান বসিয়ে $A=-1,\;B=3$।\\$\therefore \int\frac{2x^2}{(x^2+1)(x^2+3)}\,dx=-\int\frac{dx}{x^2+1}+3\int\frac{dx}{x^2+3}$\\$=-\tan^{-1}x+\sqrt{3}\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{x}{\sqrt{3}}\right)+c$।

Question: $\int\frac{dx}{x(x^2+1)}$
DetailedAnswer: (iii) মনে করি, $\frac{1}{x(x^2+1)}=\frac{A}{x}+\frac{Bx+C}{x^2+1}$।\\সহগ তুলনা করে $A=1,\;B=-1,\;C=0$।\\$\therefore \int\frac{dx}{x(x^2+1)}=\int\frac{dx}{x}-\int\frac{x\,dx}{x^2+1}$\\$=\ln|x|-\frac{1}{2}\ln|x^2+1|+c$।

Question: $\int\frac{x^2}{x^4-1}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (iv) ধরি, $\frac{x^2}{x^4-1}=\frac{A}{x+1}+\frac{B}{x-1}+\frac{Cx+D}{x^2+1}$।\\সহগ তুলনা করে $A=-\frac{1}{4},\;B=\frac{1}{4},\;C=0,\;D=\frac{1}{2}$।\\$\therefore \int\frac{x^2}{x^4-1}\,dx=-\frac{1}{4}\int\frac{dx}{x+1}+\frac{1}{4}\int\frac{dx}{x-1}+\frac{1}{2}\int\frac{dx}{1+x^2}$\\$=\frac{1}{4}\ln\left|\frac{x-1}{x+1}\right|+\frac{1}{2}\tan^{-1}x+c$।

Question: $\int\left[\frac{x+1}{(x-1)(x^2+9)}+\sqrt[3]{x}\right]dx$
$\int\frac{1-\sin x+\cos x}{1+\sin x-\cos x}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (i) প্রদত্ত যোগজ $=\int\frac{1-\sin x+\cos x}{1+\sin x-\cos x}\,dx$\\$=-\int dx+2\int\frac{dx}{1+\sin x-\cos x}$\\ধরি, $z=\tan\frac{x}{2}$, তাহলে প্রয়োজনীয় রূপান্তরে $\int\frac{dx}{1+\sin x-\cos x}=\int\frac{dz}{z(z+1)}$।\\$=-x+2\int\frac{dz}{z(z+1)}=-x+2\int\left(\frac{1}{z}-\frac{1}{z+1}\right)dz$\\$=-x+2\ln\frac{z}{z+1}+c=-x+2\ln\frac{\tan\frac{x}{2}}{1+\tan\frac{x}{2}}+c$।

Question: $\int\frac{\sin2x}{3+5\cos x}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (ii) ধরি, $I=\int\frac{\sin2x}{3+5\cos x}\,dx=\int\frac{2\sin x\cos x}{3+5\cos x}\,dx$।\\ধরি, $\cos x=z$, তাহলে $-\sin x\,dx=dz$।\\$I=-\int\frac{2z}{3+5z}\,dz=-\frac{2}{5}\int\left(1-\frac{3}{3+5z}\right)dz$\\$=-\frac{2}{5}\left(z-\frac{3}{5}\ln|3+5z|\right)+c$\\$=\frac{2}{25}\{3\ln|3+5\cos x|-5\cos x\}+c$।

Question: $\int x\cos x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: 1.(i) $\int x\cos x\,dx$\\$=x\int\cos x\,dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(x)\int\cos x\,dx\right\}dx$\\$=x\sin x-\int\sin x\,dx$\\$=x\sin x+\cos x+c$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int x^2\sin x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (ii) $\int x^2\sin x\,dx$\\$=x^2\int\sin x\,dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(x^2)\int\sin x\,dx\right\}dx$\\$=-x^2\cos x+2\int x\cos x\,dx$\\$=-x^2\cos x+2\left[x\int\cos x\,dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(x)\int\cos x\,dx\right\}dx\right]$\\$=-x^2\cos x+2x\sin x-2\int\sin x\,dx$\\$=-x^2\cos x+2x\sin x+2\cos x+c$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int x^2\cos x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (iii) $\int x^2\cos x\,dx$\\$=x^2\int\cos x\,dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(x^2)\int\cos x\,dx\right\}dx$\\$=x^2\sin x-2\int x\sin x\,dx$\\$=x^2\sin x-2\left[-x\cos x+\int\cos x\,dx\right]$\\$=x^2\sin x+2x\cos x-2\sin x+c$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int x^2e^{-3x}\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (iv) $\int x^2e^{-3x}\,dx=x^2\int e^{-3x}dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(x^2)\int e^{-3x}dx\right\}dx$\\$=-\frac{1}{3}x^2e^{-3x}+\frac{2}{3}\int xe^{-3x}dx$\\$=-\frac{1}{3}x^2e^{-3x}+\frac{2}{3}\left[x\int e^{-3x}dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(x)\int e^{-3x}dx\right\}dx\right]$\\$=-\frac{1}{3}x^2e^{-3x}+\frac{2}{3}\left[-\frac{1}{3}xe^{-3x}+\frac{1}{3}\int e^{-3x}dx\right]$\\$=-\frac{1}{3}x^2e^{-3x}-\frac{2}{9}xe^{-3x}-\frac{2}{27}e^{-3x}+c$\\$=-\frac{1}{3}\left(x^2+\frac{2}{3}x+\frac{2}{9}\right)e^{-3x}+c$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int x\sin x\cos x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (v) $\int x\sin x\cos x\,dx=\frac{1}{2}\int x(2\sin x\cos x)\,dx=\frac{1}{2}\int x\sin2x\,dx$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\left[x\int\sin2x\,dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(x)\int\sin2x\,dx\right\}dx\right]$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\left[-\frac{x\cos2x}{2}+\frac{1}{2}\int\cos2x\,dx\right]$\\$=-\frac{1}{4}x\cos2x+\frac{1}{8}\sin2x+c$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int x\sin x\sin2x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (vi) $\int x\sin x\sin2x\,dx=\frac{1}{2}\int x(2\sin x\sin2x)\,dx=\frac{1}{2}\int x(\cos x-\cos3x)\,dx$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\int x\cos x\,dx-\frac{1}{2}\int x\cos3x\,dx$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\left[x\sin x-\int\sin x\,dx\right]-\frac{1}{2}\left[\frac{1}{3}x\sin3x-\frac{1}{3}\int\sin3x\,dx\right]$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\left(x\sin x+\cos x-\frac{1}{3}x\sin3x-\frac{1}{9}\cos3x\right)+c$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int x\sec^2x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (vii) $\int x\sec^2x\,dx$\\$=x\int\sec^2x\,dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(x)\int\sec^2x\,dx\right\}dx$\\$=x\tan x-\int\tan x\,dx$\\$=x\tan x+\ln|\cos x|+c$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int x\tan^2x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (viii) $\int x\tan^2x\,dx=\int x\sec^2x\,dx-\int x\,dx$\\$=\left[x\int\sec^2x\,dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(x)\int\sec^2x\,dx\right\}dx\right]-\int x\,dx$\\$=(x\tan x-\int\tan x\,dx)-\frac{1}{2}x^2$\\$=x\tan x+\ln|\cos x|-\frac{1}{2}x^2+c$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int x\cos^2x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (ix) $\int x\cos^2x\,dx=\frac{1}{2}\int x(2\cos^2x)\,dx$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\int x(1+\cos2x)\,dx=\frac{1}{2}\int x\,dx+\frac{1}{2}\int x\cos2x\,dx$\\$=\frac{1}{4}x^2+\frac{1}{2}\left[x\int\cos2x\,dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(x)\int\cos2x\,dx\right\}dx\right]$\\$=\frac{1}{4}x^2+\frac{1}{2}\left[\frac{1}{2}x\sin2x-\frac{1}{2}\int\sin2x\,dx\right]$\\$=\frac{1}{4}x^2+\frac{1}{4}x\sin2x+\frac{1}{8}\cos2x+c$\\$=\frac{1}{4}(x^2+x\sin2x)+\frac{1}{8}\cos2x+c$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int x\sin^2\frac{x}{2}\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (x) $\int x\sin^2\frac{x}{2}\,dx=\frac{1}{2}\int x\cdot2\sin^2\frac{x}{2}\,dx$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\int x(1-\cos x)\,dx$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\int x\,dx-\frac{1}{2}\int x\cos x\,dx$\\$=\frac{1}{4}x^2-\frac{1}{2}\left[x\int\cos x\,dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(x)\int\cos x\,dx\right\}dx\right]$\\$=\frac{1}{4}x^2-\frac{1}{2}[x\sin x-\int\sin x\,dx]$\\$=\frac{1}{4}x^2-\frac{1}{2}[x\sin x+\cos x]+c$\\$=\frac{1}{4}x^2-\frac{1}{2}x\sin x-\frac{1}{2}\cos x+c$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int x\cos^3x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (xi) $\int x\cos^3x\,dx=\int x\cdot\frac{1}{4}(\cos3x+3\cos x)\,dx$\\$=\frac{1}{4}\int x\cos3x\,dx+\frac{3}{4}\int x\cos x\,dx$\\$=\frac{1}{12}x\sin3x+\frac{1}{36}\cos3x+\frac{3}{4}x\sin x+\frac{3}{4}\cos x+c$\\$=\frac{3}{4}(x\sin x+\cos x)+\frac{1}{36}(3x\sin3x+\cos3x)+c$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int x^2\cos^2x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (xii) ধরি, $I=\int x^2\cos^2x\,dx=\int x^2\cdot\frac{1}{2}(1+\cos2x)\,dx$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\left[\int x^2dx+\int x^2\cos2x\,dx\right]$\\এখন, $\int x^2\cos2x\,dx=\frac{x^2\sin2x}{2}-\int2x\cdot\frac{\sin2x}{2}\,dx$\\$=\frac{x^2\sin2x}{2}-\int x\sin2x\,dx$\\$=\frac{x^2\sin2x}{2}+\frac{x\cos2x}{2}-\frac{1}{4}\sin2x+c'$\\$\therefore I=\frac{1}{2}\left[\frac{x^3}{3}+\frac{x^2}{2}\sin2x+\frac{x}{2}\cos2x-\frac{1}{4}\sin2x\right]+c$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int e^{2x}\cos e^x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: 2.(i) $\int e^{2x}\cos e^x\,dx=\int e^x\cdot e^x\cos e^x\,dx$\\ধরি, $e^x=z\Rightarrow e^xdx=dz$।\\$=\int z\cos z\,dz$\\$=z\int\cos z\,dz-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dz}(z)\int\cos z\,dz\right\}dz$\\$=z\sin z-\int\sin z\,dz=z\sin z+\cos z+c$\\$=e^x\sin e^x+\cos e^x+c$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int x^3e^{x^2}\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (ii) $\int x^3e^{x^2}dx=\int x^2e^{x^2}\cdot x\,dx$\\ধরি, $x^2=z\Rightarrow 2xdx=dz,\;xdx=\frac{1}{2}dz$।\\$=\frac{1}{2}\int ze^z\,dz$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\left[z\int e^z\,dz-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dz}(z)\int e^z\,dz\right\}dz\right]$\\$=\frac{1}{2}[ze^z-\int e^z\,dz]=\frac{1}{2}[ze^z-e^z]+c$\\$=\frac{1}{2}e^z(z-1)+c=\frac{1}{2}(x^2-1)e^{x^2}+c$ (Ans.)

Question: Type-II. 3.(i) $\int x\ln2x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: 3.(i) $\int x\ln2x\,dx$\\$=\ln2x\int x\,dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(\ln2x)\int x\,dx\right\}dx$\\$=\ln2x\cdot\frac{x^2}{2}-\int\left\{\frac{1}{2x}\cdot x^2\right\}dx+c'$\\$=\frac{x^2\ln2x}{2}-\int\frac{x}{2}\,dx+c'=\frac{x^2\ln2x}{2}-\frac{x^2}{4}+c$ (Ans.)

Question: Type-II. 3.(ii) $\int(\ln x)^2dx$
DetailedAnswer: (ii) $\int(\ln x)^2dx$\\$=(\ln x)^2\int dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(\ln x)^2\int dx\right\}dx$\\$=x(\ln x)^2-\int\frac{2\ln x}{x}\cdot x\,dx$\\$=x(\ln x)^2-2\int\ln x\,dx$\\$=x(\ln x)^2-2\left[\ln x\int dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(\ln x)\int dx\right\}dx\right]$\\$=x(\ln x)^2-2[x\ln x-\int dx]$\\$=x(\ln x)^2-2x\ln x+2x+c$ (Ans.)

Question: Type-II. 3.(iii) $\int x^n\ln x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (iii) $\int x^n\ln x\,dx$\\$=\ln x\int x^n dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(\ln x)\int x^n dx\right\}dx$\\$=\frac{x^{n+1}\ln x}{n+1}-\int\frac{1}{x}\cdot\frac{x^{n+1}}{n+1}dx$\\$=\frac{x^{n+1}\ln x}{n+1}-\frac{1}{n+1}\int x^n dx$\\$=\frac{x^{n+1}\ln x}{n+1}-\frac{x^{n+1}}{(n+1)^2}+c$ (Ans.)

Question: Type-II. 3.(iv) $\int\frac{\ln(\ln x)}{x}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (iv) $\int\frac{\ln(\ln x)}{x}dx$\\$=\ln(\ln x)\int\frac{1}{x}\,dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(\ln(\ln x))\int\frac{1}{x}\,dx\right\}dx$\\$=\ln x\ln(\ln x)-\int\left(\frac{1}{\ln x}\cdot\frac{1}{x}\cdot\ln x\right)dx$\\$=\ln x\ln(\ln x)-\int\frac{dx}{x}$\\$=\ln x\ln(\ln x)-\ln x+c$\\$=\ln x\{\ln(\ln x)-1\}+c$ (Ans.)

Question: Type-II. 3.(v) $\int\ln(1+x)dx$
DetailedAnswer: (v) প্রদত্ত রাশি $=\int\ln(1+x)dx$\\$=\ln(1+x)\int dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}[\ln(1+x)]\int dx\right\}dx$\\$=x\ln(1+x)-\int\frac{1}{1+x}\cdot x\,dx$\\$=x\ln(1+x)-\int\frac{1+x-1}{1+x}dx$\\$=x\ln(1+x)-\int\left(1-\frac{1}{1+x}\right)dx$\\$=x\ln(1+x)-x+\ln(1+x)+c$\\$=(x+1)\ln(1+x)-x+c$ (Ans.)

Question: Type-II. 3.(vi) $\int\ln7x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (vi) $\int\ln7x\,dx=\ln7x\int dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(\ln7x)\int dx\right\}dx$\\$=x\ln7x-\int\frac{1}{7x}\cdot7\cdot x\,dx$\\$=x\ln7x-\int dx=x\ln7x-x+c$ (Ans.)

Question: Type-II. 3.(vii) $\int\cos2\theta\log_e\left(\frac{\cos\theta+\sin\theta}{\cos\theta-\sin\theta}\right)d\theta$
DetailedAnswer: (vii) ধরি, $I=\int\cos2\theta\log_e\left(\frac{\cos\theta+\sin\theta}{\cos\theta-\sin\theta}\right)d\theta$\\$=\log_e\left(\frac{\cos\theta+\sin\theta}{\cos\theta-\sin\theta}\right)\int\cos2\theta\,d\theta-\int\left[\frac{d}{d\theta}\log_e\left(\frac{\cos\theta+\sin\theta}{\cos\theta-\sin\theta}\right)\int\cos2\theta\,d\theta\right]d\theta$\\এখন, $\frac{d}{d\theta}\log_e\left(\frac{\cos\theta+\sin\theta}{\cos\theta-\sin\theta}\right)=\frac{2}{\cos2\theta}$।\\(i) নং হতে, $I=\log_e\left(\frac{\cos\theta+\sin\theta}{\cos\theta-\sin\theta}\right)\cdot\frac{1}{2}\sin2\theta-\int\frac{2}{\cos2\theta}\cdot\frac{\sin2\theta}{2}d\theta+c'$\\$=\frac{\sin2\theta}{2}\log_e\left(\frac{\cos\theta+\sin\theta}{\cos\theta-\sin\theta}\right)-\int\tan2\theta\,d\theta+c'$\\$=\frac{\sin2\theta}{2}\log_e\left(\frac{\cos\theta+\sin\theta}{\cos\theta-\sin\theta}\right)-\frac{1}{2}\ln\sec2\theta+c$ (Ans.)

Question: Type-II. 4.(i) $\int\sin^{-1}x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: 4.(i) $\int\sin^{-1}x\,dx$\\$=\sin^{-1}x\int dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(\sin^{-1}x)\int dx\right\}dx$\\$=x\sin^{-1}x-\int\frac{x}{\sqrt{1-x^2}}dx$\\$=x\sin^{-1}x+\frac{1}{2}\int\frac{-2x}{\sqrt{1-x^2}}dx$\\ধরি, $z=1-x^2\Rightarrow dz=-2xdx$।\\$=x\sin^{-1}x+\frac{1}{2}\int\frac{dz}{\sqrt{z}}$\\$=x\sin^{-1}x+\sqrt{1-x^2}+c$ (Ans.)

Question: Type-II. 4.(ii) $\int\tan^{-1}x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (ii) $\int\tan^{-1}x\,dx$\\$=\tan^{-1}x\int dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(\tan^{-1}x)\int dx\right\}dx$\\$=x\tan^{-1}x-\int\frac{x}{1+x^2}dx$\\$=x\tan^{-1}x-\frac{1}{2}\int\frac{2x\,dx}{1+x^2}$\\$=x\tan^{-1}x-\frac{1}{2}\ln|1+x^2|+c$ (Ans.)

Question: Type-II. 4.(iii) $\int\sec^{-1}x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (iii) $\int\sec^{-1}x\,dx$\\$=\sec^{-1}x\int dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(\sec^{-1}x)\int dx\right\}dx$\\$=x\sec^{-1}x-\int x\cdot\frac{1}{x\sqrt{x^2-1}}dx$\\$=x\sec^{-1}x-\int\frac{dx}{\sqrt{x^2-1}}$\\$=x\sec^{-1}x-\ln|x+\sqrt{x^2-1}|+c$ (Ans.)

Question: Type-II. 5.(i) $\int x\sin^{-1}x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: 5.(i) $\int x\sin^{-1}x\,dx$\\$=\sin^{-1}x\int xdx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(\sin^{-1}x)\int xdx\right\}dx$\\$=\frac{x^2\sin^{-1}x}{2}-\frac{1}{2}\int\frac{x^2}{\sqrt{1-x^2}}dx$\\$=\frac{x^2\sin^{-1}x}{2}-\frac{1}{2}\int\frac{1-(1-x^2)}{\sqrt{1-x^2}}dx$\\$=\frac{x^2\sin^{-1}x}{2}-\frac{1}{2}\int\frac{dx}{\sqrt{1-x^2}}+\frac{1}{2}\int\sqrt{1-x^2}\,dx$\\$=\frac{x^2\sin^{-1}x}{2}-\frac{1}{2}\sin^{-1}x+\frac{1}{2}\left[\frac{x\sqrt{1-x^2}}{2}+\frac{1}{2}\sin^{-1}x\right]+c$\\$=\frac{x^2\sin^{-1}x}{2}-\frac{1}{4}\sin^{-1}x+\frac{x\sqrt{1-x^2}}{4}+c$ (Ans.)

Question: Type-II. 5.(ii) $\int x\cos^{-1}x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (ii) ধরি, $I=\int x\cos^{-1}x\,dx$\\$=\cos^{-1}x\int xdx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(\cos^{-1}x)\int xdx\right\}dx$\\$=\frac{x^2}{2}\cos^{-1}x+\frac{1}{2}\int\frac{x^2}{\sqrt{1-x^2}}dx$\\$=\frac{x^2\cos^{-1}x}{2}+\frac{1}{2}\int\frac{1-(1-x^2)}{\sqrt{1-x^2}}dx$\\$=\frac{x^2\cos^{-1}x}{2}+\frac{1}{2}\int\frac{dx}{\sqrt{1-x^2}}-\frac{1}{2}\int\sqrt{1-x^2}\,dx$\\$=\frac{x^2\cos^{-1}x}{2}+\frac{1}{2}\sin^{-1}x-\frac{1}{2}\left[\frac{x\sqrt{1-x^2}}{2}+\frac{1}{2}\sin^{-1}x\right]+c$\\$=\frac{x^2\cos^{-1}x}{2}+\frac{1}{4}\sin^{-1}x-\frac{x\sqrt{1-x^2}}{4}+c$ (Ans.)

Question: Type-II. 5.(iii) $\int x\cot^{-1}(x-1)dx$
Type-II. 6.(i) $\int x\ln x^2dx$
DetailedAnswer: 6.(i) $\int x\ln x^2dx=\frac{1}{2}\int2x\ln x^2dx=\frac{1}{2}\int\ln z\,dz$ যেখানে $x^2=z,\;2xdx=dz$।\\$=\frac{1}{2}\left[\ln z\int dz-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dz}(\ln z)\int dz\right\}dz\right]$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\left[\ln z\cdot z-\int\frac{1}{z}\cdot z\,dz\right]=\frac{1}{2}(z\ln z-z)$\\$=\frac{1}{2}(x^2\ln x^2-x^2)+c$ (Ans.)

Question: Type-II. 6.(ii) $\int x\sin^{-1}x^2\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (ii) ধরি, $I=\int x\sin^{-1}x^2dx$; ধরি, $x^2=z$, তাই $2xdx=dz$ এবং $xdx=\frac{1}{2}dz$।\\$I=\frac{1}{2}\int\sin^{-1}z\,dz$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\left[\sin^{-1}z\int dz-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dz}(\sin^{-1}z)\int dz\right\}dz\right]$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\left[z\sin^{-1}z-\int\frac{z}{\sqrt{1-z^2}}dz\right]$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\left[z\sin^{-1}z+\sqrt{1-z^2}\right]+c$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\left[x^2\sin^{-1}(x^2)+\sqrt{1-x^4}\right]+c$\\$=\frac{1}{2}x^2\sin^{-1}(x^2)+\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{1-x^4}+c$ (Ans.)

Question: Type-II. 6.(iii) $\int x\cos^{-1}x^2\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (iii) ধরি, $I=\int x\cos^{-1}x^2dx$; ধরি, $x^2=z$, তাই $2xdx=dz$ এবং $xdx=\frac{1}{2}dz$।\\$I=\frac{1}{2}\int\cos^{-1}z\,dz$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\left[\cos^{-1}z\int dz-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dz}(\cos^{-1}z)\int dz\right\}dz\right]$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\left[z\cos^{-1}z+\int\frac{z}{\sqrt{1-z^2}}dz\right]$\\$=\frac{1}{2}[z\cos^{-1}z-\sqrt{1-z^2}]+c$\\$=\frac{1}{2}[x^2\cos^{-1}(x^2)-\sqrt{1-x^4}]+c$\\$=\frac{1}{2}x^2\cos^{-1}(x^2)-\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{1-x^4}+c$ (Ans.)

Question: Type-II. 7.(i) $\int\tan^{-1}\frac{2x}{1-x^2}\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: 7.(i) $\int\tan^{-1}\frac{2x}{1-x^2}\,dx=\int2\tan^{-1}x\,dx$\\$=2\tan^{-1}x\int dx-2\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}\tan^{-1}x\right\}\int dx$\\$=2x\tan^{-1}x-\int\frac{2x}{1+x^2}dx$\\$=2x\tan^{-1}x-\ln(1+x^2)+c$ (Ans.)

Question: Type-II. 7.(ii) $\int\sin^{-1}\frac{2x}{1+x^2}\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (ii) $\int\sin^{-1}\frac{2x}{1+x^2}\,dx=\int2\tan^{-1}x\,dx\quad[\text{কারণ} 2\tan^{-1}x=\sin^{-1}\frac{2x}{1+x^2}]$\\$=2\tan^{-1}x\int dx-2\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}\tan^{-1}x\right\}\int dx$\\$=2x\tan^{-1}x-\int\frac{2x}{1+x^2}dx$\\$=2x\tan^{-1}x-\ln(1+x^2)+c$ (Ans.)

Question: Type-II. 7.(iii) $\int\cos^{-1}\frac{1-x^2}{1+x^2}\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (iii) $\int\cos^{-1}\frac{1-x^2}{1+x^2}dx$\\$=\int2\tan^{-1}x\,dx\quad[\text{কারণ} 2\tan^{-1}x=\cos^{-1}\frac{1-x^2}{1+x^2}]$\\$=2\tan^{-1}x\int dx-2\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}\tan^{-1}x\right\}\int dx$\\$=2x\tan^{-1}x-\int\frac{2x}{1+x^2}dx$\\$=2x\tan^{-1}x-\ln(1+x^2)+c$ (Ans.)

Question: Type-II. 7.(iv) $\int\frac{\ln(\sec^{-1}x)}{x\sqrt{x^2-1}}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (iv) ধরি, $I=\int\frac{\ln(\sec^{-1}x)}{x\sqrt{x^2-1}}dx$; ধরি, $\sec^{-1}x=z$, তাই $\frac{1}{x\sqrt{x^2-1}}dx=dz$।\\$\therefore I=\int\ln z\,dz$\\$=\ln z\int dz-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dz}(\ln z)\int dz\right\}dz$\\$=\ln z\cdot z-\int\frac{1}{z}\cdot z\,dz=z\ln z-z+c$\\$=\sec^{-1}x\ln(\sec^{-1}x)-\sec^{-1}x+c$\\$=\sec^{-1}x[\ln|\sec^{-1}x|-1]+c$ (Ans.)

Question: Type-II. 7.(v) $\int\sin^{-1}\sqrt{\frac{x}{a+x}}\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (v) ধরি, $I=\int\sin^{-1}\sqrt{\frac{x}{a+x}}dx$। ধরি, $x=a\tan^2\theta$, তাহলে $dx=2a\tan\theta\sec^2\theta\,d\theta$ এবং $\theta=\tan^{-1}\sqrt{\frac{x}{a}}$।\\$\therefore I=\int\sin^{-1}\sqrt{\frac{a\tan^2\theta}{a(1+\tan^2\theta)}}\,2a\tan\theta\sec^2\theta\,d\theta$\\$=\int\sin^{-1}\left(\sqrt{\frac{\tan^2\theta}{\sec^2\theta}}\right)2a\tan\theta\sec^2\theta\,d\theta$\\$=\int\sin^{-1}(\sin\theta)\,2a\tan\theta\sec^2\theta\,d\theta$\\$=\int2a\theta\tan\theta\sec^2\theta\,d\theta$\\$=2a\left[\theta\int\tan\theta\sec^2\theta\,d\theta-\int\left\{\frac{d}{d\theta}(\theta)\int\tan\theta\sec^2\theta\,d\theta\right\}d\theta\right]$\\$=2a\left[\theta\frac{\tan^2\theta}{2}-\int\frac{\tan^2\theta}{2}d\theta\right]$\\$=a\theta\tan^2\theta-a\int(\sec^2\theta-1)d\theta$\\$=a\theta\tan^2\theta-a\tan\theta+a\theta+c$\\$=x\tan^{-1}\sqrt{\frac{x}{a}}-\sqrt{ax}+a\tan^{-1}\sqrt{\frac{x}{a}}+c$\\$=(x+a)\tan^{-1}\sqrt{\frac{x}{a}}-\sqrt{ax}+c$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int e^x\cos x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: 8.(i) ধরি, $I=\int e^x\cos x\,dx$\\$=\cos x\int e^x dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(\cos x)\int e^x dx\right\}dx$\\$=e^x\cos x+\int\sin x\cdot e^x dx$\\$=e^x\cos x+\sin x\int e^x dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(\sin x)\int e^x dx\right\}dx$\\$=e^x\cos x+e^x\sin x-\int e^x\cos x\,dx$\\$=e^x\cos x+e^x\sin x-I$\\$\therefore 2I=e^x(\cos x+\sin x)$\\$\therefore I=\frac{e^x}{2}(\cos x+\sin x)+c$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int e^x\sin x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (ii) ধরি, $I=\int e^x\sin x\,dx$\\$=e^x\int\sin xdx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(e^x)\int\sin xdx\right\}dx$\\$=-e^x\cos x+\int e^x\cos xdx$\\$=-e^x\cos x+\left[e^x\sin x-\int e^x\sin xdx\right]$\\$=e^x\sin x-e^x\cos x-I$\\বা, $2I=e^x\sin x-e^x\cos x$\\$\therefore I=\frac{1}{2}e^x(\sin x-\cos x)+c$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int e^x\sin2x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (iii) ধরি, $I=\int e^x\sin2x\,dx$\\$=e^x\int\sin2x\,dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(e^x)\int\sin2x\,dx\right\}dx$\\$=-\frac{1}{2}e^x\cos2x+\frac{1}{2}\int e^x\cos2x\,dx$\\$=-\frac{1}{2}e^x\cos2x+\frac{1}{2}\left[e^x\cdot\frac{\sin2x}{2}-\frac{1}{2}\int e^x\sin2x\,dx\right]$\\$\therefore I=-\frac{1}{2}e^x\cos2x+\frac{1}{4}e^x\sin2x-\frac{1}{4}I$\\বা, $I+\frac{1}{4}I=\frac{1}{4}e^x(\sin2x-2\cos2x)$\\বা, $I=\frac{4}{5}\cdot\frac{1}{4}e^x(\sin2x-2\cos2x)$\\$\therefore I=\frac{1}{5}e^x(\sin2x-2\cos2x)+c$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int e^{-3x}\cos4x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (iv) মনে করি, $I=\int e^{-3x}\cos4x\,dx$\\তাহলে, $I=e^{-3x}\left(\frac{1}{4}\sin4x\right)-\int(-3)e^{-3x}\left(\frac{1}{4}\sin4x\right)dx$\\$=\frac{1}{4}e^{-3x}\sin4x+\frac{3}{4}\int e^{-3x}\sin4x\,dx$\\$=\frac{1}{4}e^{-3x}\sin4x+\frac{3}{4}\left[e^{-3x}\left(-\frac{1}{4}\cos4x\right)-\int(-3)e^{-3x}\left(-\frac{1}{4}\cos4x\right)dx\right]$\\$=\frac{1}{4}e^{-3x}\sin4x-\frac{3}{16}e^{-3x}\cos4x-\frac{9}{16}I$\\$\therefore \left(1+\frac{9}{16}\right)I=\frac{e^{-3x}}{16}(4\sin4x-3\cos4x)$\\বা, $\frac{25}{16}I=\frac{e^{-3x}}{16}(4\sin4x-3\cos4x)$\\$\therefore I=\frac{1}{25}e^{-3x}(4\sin4x-3\cos4x)+c$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int e^x(\sin x+\cos x)\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: 9.(i) $\int e^x(\sin x+\cos x)\,dx=\int e^x\{f(x)+f'(x)\}dx$ যেখানে $f(x)=\sin x,\;f'(x)=\cos x$।\\$=e^xf(x)+c=e^x\sin x+c$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int e^x\left(\frac{1}{x}-\frac{1}{x^2}\right)dx$
DetailedAnswer: (ii) $\int e^x\left(\frac{1}{x}-\frac{1}{x^2}\right)dx=\int e^x\{f(x)+f'(x)\}dx$ যেখানে $f(x)=\frac{1}{x},\;f'(x)=-\frac{1}{x^2}$।\\$=e^xf(x)+c=\frac{e^x}{x}+c$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int e^x\left(\ln x+\frac{1}{x}\right)dx$
DetailedAnswer: (iii) $\int e^x\left(\ln x+\frac{1}{x}\right)dx=\int e^x\{f(x)+f'(x)\}dx$ যেখানে $f(x)=\ln x,\;f'(x)=\frac{1}{x}$।\\$=e^xf(x)+c=e^x\ln|x|+c$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int e^x\sec x(1+\tan x)dx$
DetailedAnswer: (iv) $\int e^x\sec x(1+\tan x)dx=\int e^x(\sec x+\sec x\tan x)dx$\\$=\int e^x\{f(x)+f'(x)\}dx$ যেখানে $f(x)=\sec x,\;f'(x)=\sec x\tan x$।\\$=e^xf(x)+c=e^x\sec x+c$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int e^x(\tan x-\ln|\cos x|)dx$
DetailedAnswer: 10.(i) $\int e^x(\tan x-\ln\cos x)dx=\int e^x(-\ln\cos x+\tan x)dx$\\$=\int e^x\{f(x)+f'(x)\}dx$ যেখানে $f(x)=-\ln\cos x,\;f'(x)=\tan x$।\\$=e^xf(x)+c=-e^x\ln\cos x+c$\\$=e^x\ln|\sec x|+c$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int e^{-x}\left(\frac{1}{x}+\frac{1}{x^2}\right)dx$
DetailedAnswer: (ii) $\int e^{-x}\left(\frac{1}{x}+\frac{1}{x^2}\right)dx$\\$=\int\frac{1}{x} e^{-x}dx+\int e^{-x}\frac{1}{x^2}dx$\\$=\frac{1}{x}\int e^{-x}dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}\frac{1}{x}\int e^{-x}dx\right\}dx+\int e^{-x}\frac{1}{x^2}dx$\\$=-\frac{1}{x} e^{-x}-\int\left\{-\frac{1}{x^2}\cdot\frac{e^{-x}}{-1}\right\}dx+\int e^{-x}\frac{1}{x^2}dx$\\$=-\frac{e^{-x}}{x}-\int e^{-x}\frac{1}{x^2}dx+\int e^{-x}\frac{1}{x^2}dx$\\$=-\frac{e^{-x}}{x}+c$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int e^{5x}\left(5\ln x+\frac{1}{x}\right)dx$
DetailedAnswer: (iii) $\int e^{5x}\left[5\ln x+\frac{1}{x}\right]dx=5\int e^{5x}\ln x\,dx+\int e^{5x}\frac{1}{x}\,dx$\\$=5\left[\ln x\int e^{5x}dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(\ln x)\int e^{5x}dx\right\}dx\right]+\int e^{5x}\frac{1}{x}\,dx$\\$=5\left[\ln x\cdot\frac{e^{5x}}{5}-\frac{1}{5}\int\frac{1}{x} e^{5x}dx\right]+\int e^{5x}\frac{1}{x}\,dx$\\$=e^{5x}\ln x-\int\frac{1}{x} e^{5x}dx+\int e^{5x}\frac{1}{x}\,dx$\\$=e^{5x}\ln x+c$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int e^x\left(\frac{1-x}{1+x^2}\right)^2dx$
DetailedAnswer: 11.(i) $I=\int e^x\left(\frac{1-x}{1+x^2}\right)^2dx=\int e^x\frac{1-2x+x^2}{(1+x^2)^2}dx$\\$=\int e^x\left\{\frac{1}{1+x^2}-\frac{2x}{(1+x^2)^2}\right\}dx$\\ধরি, $f(x)=\frac{1}{1+x^2}$; $\therefore f'(x)=-\frac{2x}{(1+x^2)^2}$।\\$\therefore I=\int e^x\{f(x)+f'(x)\}dx$\\$=e^xf(x)+c=\frac{e^x}{1+x^2}+c$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int e^x\frac{1+x}{(2+x)^2}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (ii) $I=\int e^x\frac{(1+x)}{(2+x)^2}dx=\int e^x\frac{(2+x)-1}{(2+x)^2}dx$\\$=\int e^x\left\{\frac{1}{2+x}-\frac{1}{(2+x)^2}\right\}dx$\\ধরি, $f(x)=\frac{1}{2+x}$; $f'(x)=-\frac{1}{(2+x)^2}$।\\$\therefore I=\int e^x\{f(x)+f'(x)\}dx$\\$=e^xf(x)+c=\frac{e^x}{2+x}+c$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int\frac{e^{m\tan^{-1}x}}{(1+x^2)^2}dx$
DetailedAnswer: 12. $I=\int\frac{e^{m\tan^{-1}x}}{(1+x^2)^2}dx$\\ধরি, $\tan^{-1}x=\theta$; $x=\tan\theta,\;dx=\sec^2\theta\,d\theta$।\\$\therefore I=\int\frac{e^{m\theta}\sec^2\theta\,d\theta}{(1+\tan^2\theta)^2}=\int\frac{e^{m\theta}\sec^2\theta}{\sec^4\theta}d\theta$\\$=\int e^{m\theta}\cos^2\theta\,d\theta=\frac{1}{2}\int e^{m\theta}(1+\cos2\theta)d\theta$\\$=\frac{1}{2m}e^{m\theta}+\frac{1}{2}I_1$ ... (i)\\এখানে, $I_1=\int e^{m\theta}\cos2\theta\,d\theta$\\$=\cos2\theta\int e^{m\theta}d\theta-\int\left\{\frac{d}{d\theta}(\cos2\theta)\int e^{m\theta}d\theta\right\}d\theta$\\$=\frac{1}{m} e^{m\theta}\cos2\theta+\frac{2}{m}\int e^{m\theta}\sin2\theta\,d\theta$\\$=\frac{1}{m} e^{m\theta}\cos2\theta+\frac{2}{m}\left[\sin2\theta\cdot\frac{1}{m} e^{m\theta}-\int2\cos2\theta\cdot\frac{1}{m} e^{m\theta}d\theta\right]$\\$=\frac{1}{m} e^{m\theta}\cos2\theta+\frac{2}{m^2}e^{m\theta}\sin2\theta-\frac{4}{m^2}I_1$\\বা, $I_1\left(1+\frac{4}{m^2}\right)=\frac{1}{m} e^{m\theta}\cos2\theta+\frac{2}{m^2}e^{m\theta}\sin2\theta$\\বা, $I_1=\frac{m^2}{m^2+4}\left[\frac{1}{m} e^{m\theta}\cos2\theta+\frac{2}{m^2}e^{m\theta}\sin2\theta\right]$।\\$\therefore$ (i) হতে, $I=\frac{1}{2m}e^{m\theta}+\frac{m^2}{2(m^2+4)}\left[\frac{1}{m} e^{m\theta}\cos2\theta+\frac{2}{m^2}e^{m\theta}\sin2\theta\right]+c$\\$=e^{m\tan^{-1}x}\left[\frac{1}{2m}+\frac{m^2}{2(m^2+4)}\left\{\frac{1}{m}\cdot\frac{1-x^2}{1+x^2}+\frac{2}{m^2}\cdot\frac{2x}{1+x^2}\right\}\right]+c$\\$=e^{m\tan^{-1}x}\left[\frac{1}{2m}+\frac{m^2}{2(m^2+4)}\left\{\frac{1-x^2}{m(1+x^2)}+\frac{4x}{m^2(1+x^2)}\right\}\right]+c$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int x^2(\ln x)^2dx$
DetailedAnswer: 13. $\int x^2(\ln x)^2dx$\\$=(\ln x)^2\int x^2dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(\ln x)^2\int x^2dx\right\}dx$\\$=\frac{1}{3}x^3(\ln x)^2-\frac{2}{3}\int\frac{\ln x}{x}\cdot x^3dx$\\$=\frac{1}{3}x^3(\ln x)^2-\frac{2}{3}\int\ln(x)\cdot x^2dx$\\$=\frac{1}{3}x^3(\ln x)^2-\frac{2}{3}\left[\ln(x)\int x^2dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(\ln x)\int x^2dx\right\}dx\right]$\\$=\frac{1}{3}x^3(\ln x)^2-\frac{2}{3}\left[\frac{1}{3}x^3\ln x-\frac{1}{3}\int\frac{1}{x}\cdot x^3dx\right]$\\$=\frac{1}{3}x^3(\ln x)^2-\frac{2}{9}x^3\ln x+\frac{2}{9}\int x^2dx$\\$=\frac{1}{3}x^3(\ln x)^2-\frac{2}{9}x^3\ln x+\frac{2}{27}x^3+c$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^4\frac{dx}{\sqrt{2x+1}}$
$\int_0^1x(1-\sqrt{x})^2dx$
$\int_0^4\left(\sqrt{x}+\frac{1}{\sqrt{x}}\right)dx$
$\int_0^1\frac{dx}{\sqrt{1-x^2}}$
$\int_2^3\frac{dx}{9x^2-16}$
DetailedAnswer: (viii) $\int_2^3\frac{dx}{9x^2-16}=\frac{1}{9}\int_2^3\frac{dx}{x^2-\frac{16}{9}}=\frac{1}{9}\int_2^3\frac{dx}{x^2-\left(\frac{4}{3}\right)^2}$\\$=\frac{1}{9}\left[\frac{1}{2\cdot\frac{4}{3}}\ln\left|\frac{x-\frac{4}{3}}{x+\frac{4}{3}}\right|\right]_2^3$\\$=\frac{1}{24}\left[\ln\left|\frac{x-\frac{4}{3}}{x+\frac{4}{3}}\right|\right]_2^3$\\$=\frac{1}{24}\left[\ln\frac{5}{13}-\ln\frac{1}{5}\right]=\frac{1}{24}\ln\frac{25}{13}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^1\frac{dx}{\sqrt{4-3x^2}}$
DetailedAnswer: (ix) $\int_0^1\frac{dx}{\sqrt{4-3x^2}}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\int_0^1\frac{dx}{\sqrt{\left(\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\right)^2-x^2}}$\\$=\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\left[\sin^{-1}\frac{\sqrt{3x}}{2}\right]_0^1=\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\sin^{-1}\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$\\$=\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\cdot\frac{\pi}{3}=\frac{\pi}{3\sqrt{3}}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^1\frac{dx}{\sqrt{x+1}+\sqrt{x}}$
$\int_0^{\pi/2}\cos4x\,dx$
$\int_0^{\pi/2}(\sin\theta+\cos\theta)d\theta$
DetailedAnswer: (ii) $\int_0^{\pi/2}(\sin\theta+\cos\theta)d\theta=[-\cos\theta+\sin\theta]_0^{\pi/2}$\\$=[-\cos\frac{\pi}{2}+\sin\frac{\pi}{2}]-[-\cos0+\sin0]$\\$=(0+1)-(-1+0)=2$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/4}\tan^2\theta\,d\theta$
DetailedAnswer: (iii) $\int_0^{\pi/4}\tan^2\theta\,d\theta=\int_0^{\pi/4}(\sec^2\theta-1)d\theta$\\$=[\tan\theta-\theta]_0^{\pi/4}=\tan\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\pi}{4}-\tan0+0$\\$=1-\frac{\pi}{4}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/4}\frac{1-\cos2\theta}{1+\cos2\theta}d\theta$
DetailedAnswer: (iv) $\int_0^{\pi/4}\frac{1-\cos2\theta}{1+\cos2\theta}d\theta=\int_0^{\pi/4}\frac{2\sin^2\theta}{2\cos^2\theta}d\theta$\\$=\int_0^{\pi/4}\tan^2\theta\,d\theta=\int_0^{\pi/4}(\sec^2\theta-1)d\theta$\\$=[\tan\theta-\theta]_0^{\pi/4}=1-\frac{\pi}{4}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{dx}{1+\cos x}$
DetailedAnswer: (v) $\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{dx}{1+\cos x}=\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{dx}{2\cos^2\frac{x}{2}}$\\$=\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{1}{2}\sec^2\frac{x}{2}\,dx=\left[\tan\frac{x}{2}\right]_0^{\pi/2}$\\$=\tan\frac{\pi}{4}-\tan0=1$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/4}\frac{dx}{1+\cos2x}$
$\int_0^{\pi/4}\frac{dx}{1-\cos2x}$
DetailedAnswer: (vii) $\int_0^{\pi/4}\frac{dx}{1-\cos2x}=\int_0^{\pi/4}\frac{dx}{2\sin^2x}$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\int_0^{\pi/4}\cosec^2x\,dx=\frac{1}{2}[-\cot x]_0^{\pi/4}$\\$=-\frac{1}{2}[\cot\frac{\pi}{4}-\cot0]=-\frac{1}{2}[1-\infty]=\infty$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/3}\frac{dx}{1-\sin x}$
DetailedAnswer: (viii) $\int_0^{\pi/3}\frac{dx}{1-\sin x}=\int_0^{\pi/3}\frac{(1+\sin x)dx}{1-\sin^2x}$\\$=\int_0^{\pi/3}\frac{1+\sin x}{\cos^2x}dx=\int_0^{\pi/3}(\sec^2x+\sec x\tan x)dx$\\$=[\tan x+\sec x]_0^{\pi/3}=\tan\frac{\pi}{3}+\sec\frac{\pi}{3}-(\tan0+\sec0)$\\$=(\sqrt{3}+2)-(0+1)=\sqrt{3}+1$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/4}\frac{dx}{1+\sin x}$
DetailedAnswer: (ix) $\int_0^{\pi/4}\frac{dx}{1+\sin x}=\int_0^{\pi/4}\frac{(1-\sin x)dx}{(1+\sin x)(1-\sin x)}$\\$=\int_0^{\pi/4}\frac{1-\sin x}{1-\sin^2x}dx=\int_0^{\pi/4}\left(\frac{1}{\cos^2x}-\frac{\sin x}{\cos^2x}\right)dx$\\$=\int_0^{\pi/4}(\sec^2x-\tan x\sec x)dx$\\$=[\tan x-\sec x]_0^{\pi/4}=(\tan\frac{\pi}{4}-\sec\frac{\pi}{4})-(\tan0-\sec0)$\\$=1-\sqrt{2}-0+1=2-\sqrt{2}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/2}\sqrt{1+\cos x}\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (x) $\int_0^{\pi/2}\sqrt{1+\cos x}\,dx=\int_0^{\pi/2}\sqrt{2\cos^2\frac{x}{2}}\,dx$\\$=\sqrt{2}\int_0^{\pi/2}\cos\frac{x}{2}\,dx=\sqrt{2}\left[\frac{\sin\frac{x}{2}}{1/2}\right]_0^{\pi/2}$\\$=2\sqrt{2}\left[\sin\frac{\pi}{4}-\sin0\right]=2\sqrt{2}\cdot\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}=2$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^\pi3\sqrt{1-\cos x}\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (xi) $\int_0^\pi3\sqrt{1-\cos x}\,dx=\int_0^\pi3\sqrt{1-\cos\left(2\cdot\frac{x}{2}\right)}dx$\\$=3\int_0^\pi\sqrt{2\sin^2\frac{x}{2}}dx=3\sqrt{2}\int_0^\pi\sin\frac{x}{2}\,dx$\\$=3\sqrt{2}\left[\frac{-\cos\frac{x}{2}}{1/2}\right]_0^\pi=-6\sqrt{2}\left(\cos\frac{\pi}{2}-\cos0\right)$\\$=-6\sqrt{2}(0-1)=6\sqrt{2}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/2}\sqrt{1+\sin x}\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (xii) $\int_0^{\pi/2}\sqrt{1+\sin x}\,dx=\int_0^{\pi/2}\sqrt{\sin^2\frac{x}{2}+\cos^2\frac{x}{2}+2\sin\frac{x}{2}\cos\frac{x}{2}}\,dx$\\$=\int_0^{\pi/2}\left(\sin\frac{x}{2}+\cos\frac{x}{2}\right)dx$\\$=\left[-2\cos\frac{x}{2}+2\sin\frac{x}{2}\right]_0^{\pi/2}$\\$=2\left[-\cos\frac{\pi}{4}+\cos0+\sin\frac{\pi}{4}-\sin0\right]$\\$=2\left[-\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}+1+\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}-0\right]=2$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_{-\pi/2}^{\pi/2}\frac{\sec x+1}{\sec x}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (xiii) $\int_{-\pi/2}^{\pi/2}\frac{\sec x+1}{\sec x}dx=\int_{-\pi/2}^{\pi/2}(1+\cos x)dx$\\$=[x+\sin x]_{-\pi/2}^{\pi/2}=\left(\frac{\pi}{2}+\sin\frac{\pi}{2}\right)-\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}-\sin\frac{\pi}{2}\right)$\\$=\frac{\pi}{2}+1+\frac{\pi}{2}+1=\pi+2$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/4}\frac{\cos2x}{\cos^2x}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (xiv) $\int_0^{\pi/4}\frac{\cos2x}{\cos^2x}dx=\int_0^{\pi/4}\frac{2\cos^2x-1}{\cos^2x}dx$\\$=\int_0^{\pi/4}(2-\sec^2x)dx=[2x-\tan x]_0^{\pi/4}$\\$=\frac{\pi}{2}-\tan\frac{\pi}{4}-0+\tan0=\frac{\pi}{2}-1$ (Ans.)

Question: Type-II. 3.(i) $\int_0^1\frac{e^{\sqrt{x}}}{\sqrt{x}}dx$
DetailedAnswer: 3.(i) $\int_0^1\frac{e^{\sqrt{x}}}{\sqrt{x}}dx$\\ধরি, $z=\sqrt{x}$; $\therefore dz=\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}dx$। সীমা: $x=0$ হলে $z=0$ এবং $x=1$ হলে $z=1$।\\$=2\int_0^1e^z dz=2[e^z]_0^1=2(e^1-e^0)=2(e-1)$ (Ans.)

Question: Type-II. 3.(ii) $\int_2^3\frac{2x}{1+x^2}dx$
Type-II. 3.(iii) $\int_4^8\frac{x\,dx}{\sqrt{x^2-15}}$
Type-II. 3.(iv) $\int_0^1\frac{x\,dx}{\sqrt{1-x^2}}$
Type-II. 3.(v) $\int_0^2\frac{x\,dx}{\sqrt{9-2x^2}}$
Type-II. 3.(vi) $\int_0^1\frac{x\,dx}{\sqrt{4-x^2}}$
$\int_0^1 xe^{x^2}dx$
$\int_a^b\frac{\ln x}{x}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (iii) $\int_a^b\frac{\ln x}{x}dx=\int_{\ln a}^{\ln b}z\,dz$ যেখানে $z=\ln x$ এবং $dz=\frac{dx}{x}$।\\$=\left[\frac{z^2}{2}\right]_{\ln a}^{\ln b}=\frac{(\ln b)^2}{2}-\frac{(\ln a)^2}{2}$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\{(\ln b)^2-(\ln a)^2\}=\frac{1}{2}(\ln b+\ln a)(\ln b-\ln a)$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\ln(ab)\ln\left(\frac{b}{a}\right)$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_1^3\frac{1}{x}\cos(\ln x)dx$
DetailedAnswer: (iv) $\int_1^3\frac{\cos(\ln x)}{x} dx$\\ধরি, $u=\ln x$; $\therefore du=\frac{1}{x} dx$। সীমা: $x=1$ হলে $u=\ln1=0$ এবং $x=3$ হলে $u=\ln3$।\\$=\int_0^{\ln3}\cos u\,du=[\sin u]_0^{\ln3}$\\$=\sin(\ln3)$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_1^{e^2}\frac{dx}{x(1+\ln x)}$
DetailedAnswer: (vi) $\int_1^{e^2}\frac{dx}{x(1+\ln x)}$\\ধরি, $u=1+\ln x$; $\therefore du=\frac{1}{x} dx$। সীমা: $x=1$ হলে $u=1$ এবং $x=e^2$ হলে $u=3$।\\$=\int_1^3\frac{du}{u}=[\ln u]_1^3=\ln3-\ln1=\ln3$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^\pi3\sqrt{1-\cos x}\sin x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (viii) $\int_0^\pi3\sqrt{1-\cos x}\sin x\,dx$\\ধরি, $z=1-\cos x$; $\therefore dz=\sin x\,dx$। সীমা: $x=0$ হলে $z=0$ এবং $x=\pi$ হলে $z=2$।\\$=3\int_0^2\sqrt{z}\,dz=3\left[\frac{z^{3/2}}{3/2}\right]_0^2$\\$=3\cdot\frac{2}{3}(2^{3/2}-0)=4\sqrt{2}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{\cos\theta}{(1+\sin\theta)^3}d\theta$
DetailedAnswer: (ix) $\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{\cos\theta}{(1+\sin\theta)^3}d\theta$\\ধরি, $z=1+\sin\theta$; $\therefore dz=\cos\theta d\theta$। সীমা: $\theta=0$ হলে $z=1$ এবং $\theta=\frac{\pi}{2}$ হলে $z=2$।\\$=\int_1^2\frac{dz}{z^3}=\left[-\frac{1}{2z^2}\right]_1^2$\\$=-\frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{1}{2^2}-\frac{1}{1^2}\right)=\frac{3}{8}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^1\frac{(\tan^{-1}x)^2}{1+x^2}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (x) $\int_0^1\frac{(\tan^{-1}x)^2}{1+x^2}dx$\\ধরি, $u=\tan^{-1}x$; $\therefore du=\frac{1}{1+x^2}dx$। সীমা: $x=0$ হলে $u=0$ এবং $x=1$ হলে $u=\frac{\pi}{4}$।\\$=\int_0^{\pi/4}u^2du=\left[\frac{u^3}{3}\right]_0^{\pi/4}$\\$=\frac{1}{3}\left[\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)^3-0\right]=\frac{\pi^3}{192}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^1\frac{\sin^{-1}x}{\sqrt{1-x^2}}dx$
$\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{\cos x}{9-\sin^2x}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (xii) $\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{\cos x}{9-\sin^2x}dx$\\ধরি, $\sin x=z$; $\therefore \cos xdx=dz$। সীমা: $x=0$ হলে $z=0$ এবং $x=\frac{\pi}{2}$ হলে $z=1$।\\$=\int_0^1\frac{dz}{9-z^2}=\frac{1}{6}\left[\ln\frac{3+z}{3-z}\right]_0^1$\\$=\frac{1}{6}\left[\ln\frac{3+1}{3-1}-\ln\frac{3+0}{3-0}\right]$\\$=\frac{1}{6}(\ln2-\ln1)=\frac{1}{6}\ln2$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/4}\tan^2x\sec^2x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (xiii) $\int_0^{\pi/4}\tan^2x\sec^2x\,dx$\\মনে করি, $\tan x=z$; $\therefore \sec^2xdx=dz$। সীমা: $x=0$ হলে $z=0$ এবং $x=\frac{\pi}{4}$ হলে $z=1$।\\$=\int_0^1z^2dz=\frac{1}{3}[z^3]_0^1=\frac{1}{3}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/4}4\tan^3x\sec^2x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (xiv) $\int_0^{\pi/4}4\tan^3x\sec^2x\,dx$\\মনে করি, $\tan x=z$; $\therefore \sec^2xdx=dz$। সীমা: $x=0$ হলে $z=0$ এবং $x=\frac{\pi}{4}$ হলে $z=1$।\\$=\int_0^14z^3dz=4\left[\frac{z^4}{4}\right]_0^1=1$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/4}\sin^3\theta\cos\theta\,d\theta$
DetailedAnswer: (xv) $\int_0^{\pi/4}\sin^3\theta\cos\theta\,d\theta$\\ধরি, $z=\sin\theta$; $\therefore dz=\cos\theta d\theta$। সীমা: $\theta=0$ হলে $z=0$ এবং $\theta=\frac{\pi}{4}$ হলে $z=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$।\\$=\int_0^{1/\sqrt{2}}z^3dz=\frac{1}{4}[z^4]_0^{1/\sqrt{2}}$\\$=\frac{1}{4}\left[\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\right)^4-0\right]=\frac{1}{4}\cdot\frac{1}{4}=\frac{1}{16}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/2}\cos^5\theta\sin\theta\,d\theta$
DetailedAnswer: (xvi) $\int_0^{\pi/2}\cos^5\theta\sin\theta\,d\theta$\\ধরি, $z=\cos\theta$; $\therefore dz=-\sin\theta d\theta$। সীমা: $\theta=0$ হলে $z=1$ এবং $\theta=\frac{\pi}{2}$ হলে $z=0$।\\$=-\int_1^0z^5dz=\left[\frac{z^6}{6}\right]_0^1=\frac{1}{6}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^1\frac{(\cos^{-1}x)^3}{\sqrt{1-x^2}}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (xvii) $\int_0^1\frac{(\cos^{-1}x)^3}{\sqrt{1-x^2}}dx$\\ধরি, $z=\cos^{-1}x$; $\therefore dz=\frac{-dx}{\sqrt{1-x^2}}$। সীমা: $x=0$ হলে $z=\frac{\pi}{2}$ এবং $x=1$ হলে $z=0$।\\$=-\int_{\pi/2}^0z^3dz=\int_0^{\pi/2}z^3dz=\frac{1}{4}[z^4]_0^{\pi/2}$\\$=\frac{1}{4}\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)^4=\frac{\pi^4}{64}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^1\frac{(\sin^{-1}x)^2}{\sqrt{1-x^2}}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (xviii) $\int_0^1\frac{(\sin^{-1}x)^2}{\sqrt{1-x^2}}dx$\\মনে করি, $\sin^{-1}x=z$; $\therefore \frac{1}{\sqrt{1-x^2}}dx=dz$। সীমা: $x=0$ হলে $z=0$ এবং $x=1$ হলে $z=\frac{\pi}{2}$।\\$\therefore I=\int_0^{\pi/2}z^2dz=\left[\frac{z^3}{3}\right]_0^{\pi/2}$\\$=\frac{1}{3}\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)^3=\frac{\pi^3}{24}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/2}(1+\cos x)^2\sin x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (xix) $\int_0^{\pi/2}(1+\cos x)^2\sin x\,dx$\\ধরি, $1+\cos x=z$; $\therefore -\sin xdx=dz$ বা, $\sin xdx=-dz$। সীমা: $x=0$ হলে $z=2$ এবং $x=\frac{\pi}{2}$ হলে $z=1$।\\$=-\int_2^1z^2dz=\int_1^2z^2dz=\frac{1}{3}[z^3]_1^2$\\$=\frac{1}{3}(2^3-1)=\frac{7}{3}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^\pi\frac{-\sin x}{1+\cos^2x}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (xx) $\int_0^\pi\frac{-\sin x}{1+\cos^2x}dx$\\ধরি, $\cos x=z$; $\therefore -\sin xdx=dz$। সীমা: $x=0$ হলে $z=1$ এবং $x=\pi$ হলে $z=-1$।\\$=-\int_1^{-1}\frac{dz}{1+z^2}=-[\tan^{-1}z]_1^{-1}$\\$=-[\tan^{-1}(-1)-\tan^{-1}(1)]=-\left[-\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\pi}{4}\right]=\frac{\pi}{2}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{\cos x}{1+\sin^2x}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (xxi) $\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{\cos x}{1+\sin^2x}dx$\\ধরি, $\sin x=z$; $\therefore \cos xdx=dz$। সীমা: $x=0$ হলে $z=0$ এবং $x=\frac{\pi}{2}$ হলে $z=1$।\\$=\int_0^1\frac{dz}{1+z^2}=[\tan^{-1}z]_0^1$\\$=\tan^{-1}1-\tan^{-1}0=\frac{\pi}{4}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{\cos\theta}{\sqrt{4-\sin^2\theta}}d\theta$
DetailedAnswer: (xxii) $\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{\cos\theta}{\sqrt{4-\sin^2\theta}}d\theta$\\ধরি, $z=\sin\theta$; $\therefore dz=\cos\theta d\theta$। সীমা: $\theta=0$ হলে $z=0$ এবং $\theta=\frac{\pi}{2}$ হলে $z=1$।\\$=\int_0^1\frac{dz}{\sqrt{2^2-z^2}}=\left[\sin^{-1}\frac{z}{2}\right]_0^1$\\$=\sin^{-1}\frac{1}{2}-0=\frac{\pi}{6}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^1\frac{2x(\tan^{-1}x^2)^3}{1+x^4}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (xxiii) $\int_0^1\frac{2x(\tan^{-1}x^2)^3}{1+x^4}dx$\\ধরি, $z=\tan^{-1}x^2$; $\therefore dz=\frac{2xdx}{1+x^4}$। সীমা: $x=0$ হলে $z=0$ এবং $x=1$ হলে $z=\frac{\pi}{4}$।\\$=\int_0^{\pi/4}z^3dz=\left[\frac{z^4}{4}\right]_0^{\pi/4}$\\$=\frac{1}{4}\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)^4=\frac{\pi^4}{1024}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_1^3\frac{1}{x}\sqrt{1-\{\cos(\ln x)\}^2}\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (xxiv) $\int_1^3\frac{1}{x}\sqrt{1-\{\cos(\ln x)\}^2}dx=\int_1^3\frac{1}{x}\sqrt{\sin^2(\ln x)}dx$\\ধরি, $\ln x=z$; $\therefore \frac{1}{x}dx=dz$। সীমা: $x=1$ হলে $z=0$ এবং $x=3$ হলে $z=\ln3$।\\$=\int_0^{\ln3}\sin z\,dz=[-\cos z]_0^{\ln3}$\\$=-(\cos(\ln3)-\cos0)=1-\cos(\ln3)$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^\pi\sin^8x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (xxvi) প্রদত্ত যোগজ $=\int_0^\pi\sin^8x\,dx$।\\এখানে, $\sin^8x=\frac{1}{2^4}(2\sin^2x)^4=\frac{1}{2^4}(1-\cos2x)^4$।\\$=\frac{1}{2^4}\int_0^\pi(1-4\cos2x+6\cos^2 2x-4\cos^3 2x+\cos^4 2x)dx$\\$=\frac{x}{16}-\frac{\sin2x}{8}+\frac{3x}{16}+\frac{3\sin4x}{64}-\frac{\sin6x}{96}-\frac{3\sin2x}{32}+\frac{x}{64}+\frac{\sin4x}{128}+\frac{x}{128}+\frac{\sin8x}{1024}$\\$=\frac{35x}{128}-\frac{7\sin2x}{32}+\frac{7\sin4x}{128}-\frac{\sin6x}{96}+\frac{\sin8x}{1024}$।\\$\therefore 0$ থেকে $\pi$ পর্যন্ত চিহ্নিত যোগজ $=\left(\frac{35\pi}{128}-0+0-0+0\right)-0=\frac{35\pi}{128}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{\sin x}{3+\sin^2x}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (xxvii) প্রদত্ত রাশি $=\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{\sin x}{3+\sin^2x}dx$\\$=\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{\sin x}{3+1-\cos^2x}dx=\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{\sin x}{4-\cos^2x}dx$\\ধরি, $\cos x=z$; $\therefore -\sin xdx=dz$। সীমা: $x=0$ হলে $z=1$ এবং $x=\frac{\pi}{2}$ হলে $z=0$।\\$=-\int_1^0\frac{dz}{4-z^2}=\int_0^1\frac{dz}{4-z^2}$\\$=\left[\frac{1}{4}\ln\left|\frac{2+z}{2-z}\right|\right]_0^1$\\$=\frac{1}{4}(\ln3-0)=\frac{\ln3}{4}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/4}\frac{30\sec^2x}{(\tan^2x-9)(\tan x-2)}dx$
$\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{\cos x}{(1+\sin x)(2+\sin x)}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (xxix) $I=\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{\cos x}{(1+\sin x)(2+\sin x)}dx$\\ধরি, $1+\sin x=z$; $\therefore \cos xdx=dz$। সীমা: $x=0$ হলে $z=1$ এবং $x=\frac{\pi}{2}$ হলে $z=2$।\\$=\int_1^2\frac{dz}{z(z+1)}=\int_1^2\left(\frac{1}{z}-\frac{1}{z+1}\right)dz$\\$=[\ln z-\ln(z+1)]_1^2=\left[\ln\frac{z}{z+1}\right]_1^2$\\$=\ln\frac{2}{3}-\ln\frac{1}{2}=\ln\left(\frac{2}{3}\cdot2\right)=\ln\frac{4}{3}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/2}\sin^6x\cos x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (xxx) প্রদত্ত যোগজ $=\int_0^{\pi/2}\sin^6x\cos x\,dx$।\\ধরি, $\sin x=z$; $\therefore \cos xdx=dz$। সীমা: $x=0$ হলে $z=0$ এবং $x=\frac{\pi}{2}$ হলে $z=1$।\\$=\int_0^1z^6dz=\left[\frac{z^7}{7}\right]_0^1=\frac{1}{7}(1-0)=\frac{1}{7}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^1\frac{1-x}{1+x}dx$
$\int_{-1}^1\sqrt{\frac{1-x}{1+x}}dx$
$\int_0^a\sqrt{\frac{a+x}{a-x}}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (iv) $\int_0^a\sqrt{\frac{a+x}{a-x}}dx=\int_0^a\sqrt{\frac{(a+x)(a+x)}{(a-x)(a+x)}}dx$\\$=\int_0^a\frac{a+x}{\sqrt{a^2-x^2}}dx=a\int_0^a\frac{dx}{\sqrt{a^2-x^2}}+\int_0^a\frac{x\,dx}{\sqrt{a^2-x^2}}$\\$=a\left[\sin^{-1}\frac{x}{a}\right]_0^a-\left[\sqrt{a^2-x^2}\right]_0^a$\\$=a\left(\sin^{-1}\frac{a}{a}-0\right)-[0-a]$\\$=\frac{a\pi}{2}+a=\frac{a}{2}(\pi+2)$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^4\frac{x^3}{\sqrt{x^2+9}}dx$
$\int_1^3\frac{x-3}{x^3+x^2}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (iii) $\int_1^3\frac{x-3}{x^3+x^2}dx=\int_1^3\frac{x-3}{x^2(x+1)}dx$।\\$\frac{x-3}{x^2(x+1)}=\frac{1}{x}\left[\frac{x-3}{x(x+1)}\right]=\frac{1}{x}\left[-\frac{3}{x}+\frac{4}{x+1}\right]$\\$=-\frac{3}{x^2}+\frac{4}{x(x+1)}=-\frac{3}{x^2}+\frac{4}{x}-\frac{4}{x+1}$।\\$\therefore \int_1^3\frac{x-3}{x^2(x+1)}dx=\left[4\ln\left|\frac{x}{x+1}\right|+\frac{3}{x}\right]_1^3$\\$=\left(4\ln\frac{3}{4}+1\right)-\left(4\ln\frac{1}{2}+3\right)=4\ln\left(\frac{3}{2}\right)-2$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^4\frac{dx}{(4+x^2)^{3/2}}$
DetailedAnswer: (iv) ধরি, $I=\int_0^4\frac{dx}{(4+x^2)^{3/2}}$। ধরি, $x=2\tan\theta$; $\therefore dx=2\sec^2\theta d\theta$।\\$\int\frac{dx}{(4+x^2)^{3/2}}=\int\frac{2\sec^2\theta d\theta}{\{4(1+\tan^2\theta)\}^{3/2}}=\frac{1}{4}\int\cos\theta\,d\theta$\\$=\frac{1}{4}\sin\theta+c=\frac{x}{4\sqrt{x^2+4}}+c$।\\$\therefore I=\left[\frac{x}{4\sqrt{x^2+4}}\right]_0^4=\frac{4}{4\sqrt{16+4}}-0=\frac{1}{2\sqrt{5}}$ (Ans.)

Question: Type-IV. 7.(i) $\int_0^{\pi/2}\cos^2x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: 7.(i) $\int_0^{\pi/2}\cos^2x\,dx=\frac{1}{2}\int_0^{\pi/2}2\cos^2x\,dx$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\int_0^{\pi/2}(1+\cos2x)dx=\frac{1}{2}\left[x+\frac{\sin2x}{2}\right]_0^{\pi/2}$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\left[\frac{\pi}{2}+\frac{\sin\pi}{2}-0\right]=\frac{\pi}{4}$ (Ans.)

Question: Type-IV. 7.(ii) $\int_0^{\pi/2}\sin^2x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (ii) $\int_0^{\pi/2}\sin^2x\,dx=\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{1}{2}\cdot2\sin^2x\,dx$\\$=\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{1}{2}(1-\cos2x)dx=\frac{1}{2}\left[x-\frac{1}{2}\sin2x\right]_0^{\pi/2}$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\left[\frac{\pi}{2}-\frac{1}{2}\sin\pi-0\right]=\frac{\pi}{4}$ (Ans.)

Question: Type-IV. 7.(iii) $\int_0^{\pi/2}(a\cos^2x+b\sin^2x)dx$
DetailedAnswer: (iii) মনে করি, $I=\int_0^{\pi/2}(a\cos^2x+b\sin^2x)dx$\\$=\frac{a}{2}\int_0^{\pi/2}2\cos^2x\,dx+\frac{b}{2}\int_0^{\pi/2}2\sin^2x\,dx$\\$=\frac{a}{2}\int_0^{\pi/2}(1+\cos2x)dx+\frac{b}{2}\int_0^{\pi/2}(1-\cos2x)dx$\\$=\frac{a}{2}\left[x+\frac{\sin2x}{2}\right]_0^{\pi/2}+\frac{b}{2}\left[x-\frac{\sin2x}{2}\right]_0^{\pi/2}$\\$=\frac{a\pi}{4}+\frac{b\pi}{4}=\frac{1}{4}(a+b)\pi$ (Ans.)

Question: Type-IV. 7.(iv) $\int_0^{\pi/2}\cos^3x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (iv) $\int_0^{\pi/2}\cos^3x\,dx=\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{1}{4}(\cos3x+3\cos x)dx$\\$=\frac{1}{4}\left[\frac{1}{3}\sin3x+3\sin x\right]_0^{\pi/2}$\\$=\frac{1}{4}\left[\frac{1}{3}\sin\frac{3\pi}{2}+3\sin\frac{\pi}{2}\right]-0$\\$=\frac{1}{4}\left[-\frac{1}{3}+3\right]=\frac{2}{3}$ (Ans.)

Question: Type-IV. 7.(v) $\int_0^{\pi/2}\sin^3\theta\,d\theta$
DetailedAnswer: (v) $\int_0^{\pi/2}\sin^3\theta\,d\theta=\frac{1}{4}\int_0^{\pi/2}(3\sin\theta-\sin3\theta)d\theta$\\$=\frac{1}{4}\left[-3\cos\theta+\frac{1}{3}\cos3\theta\right]_0^{\pi/2}$\\$=\frac{1}{4}\left[\left(-3\cos\frac{\pi}{2}+\frac{1}{3}\cos\frac{3\pi}{2}\right)-\left(-3\cos0+\frac{1}{3}\cos0\right)\right]$\\$=\frac{1}{4}\left(0-\left(-\frac{8}{3}\right)\right)=\frac{2}{3}$ (Ans.)

Question: Type-IV. 7.(vi) $\int_0^{\pi/4}\sin^4x\,dx$
Type-IV. 7.(vii) $\int_0^{\pi/4}\cos^4\theta\,d\theta$
DetailedAnswer: (vii) প্রদত্ত যোগজ $=\int_0^{\pi/4}\cos^4\theta\,d\theta$\\$=\frac{1}{4}\int_0^{\pi/4}(2\cos^2\theta)^2d\theta=\frac{1}{4}\int_0^{\pi/4}(1+\cos2\theta)^2d\theta$\\$=\frac{1}{4}\int_0^{\pi/4}\left(1+2\cos2\theta+\cos^2 2\theta\right)d\theta$\\$=\frac{1}{4}\int_0^{\pi/4}\left\{1+2\cos2\theta+\frac{1}{2}(1+\cos4\theta)\right\}d\theta$\\$=\frac{1}{4}\left[\frac{3}{2}\theta+\sin2\theta+\frac{1}{8}\sin4\theta\right]_0^{\pi/4}$\\$=\frac{1}{4}\left[\frac{3\pi}{8}+1+0\right]=\frac{3\pi}{32}+\frac{1}{4}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/2}\sin2x\cos x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: 8.(i) $\int_0^{\pi/2}\sin2x\cos x\,dx=\frac{1}{2}\int_0^{\pi/2}2\sin2x\cos x\,dx$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\int_0^{\pi/2}(\sin3x+\sin x)dx=\frac{1}{2}\left[-\frac{1}{3}\cos3x-\cos x\right]_0^{\pi/2}$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\left[\left(-\frac{1}{3}\cos\frac{3\pi}{2}-\cos\frac{\pi}{2}\right)-\left(-\frac{1}{3}\cos0-\cos0\right)\right]$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{4}{3}=\frac{2}{3}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/2}\cos3\theta\cos2\theta\,d\theta$
DetailedAnswer: (ii) $\int_0^{\pi/2}\cos3\theta\cos2\theta\,d\theta=\frac{1}{2}\int_0^{\pi/2}2\cos3\theta\cos2\theta\,d\theta$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\int_0^{\pi/2}(\cos5\theta+\cos\theta)d\theta$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\left[\frac{1}{5}\sin5\theta+\sin\theta\right]_0^{\pi/2}$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\left[\frac{1}{5}\sin\frac{5\pi}{2}+\sin\frac{\pi}{2}\right]=\frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{1}{5}+1\right)=\frac{3}{5}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/2}\sin^2x\sin3x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (iii) $\int_0^{\pi/2}\sin^2x\sin3x\,dx=\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{1}{2}(1-\cos2x)\sin3x\,dx$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\int_0^{\pi/2}(\sin3x-\sin3x\cos2x)dx$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\int_0^{\pi/2}\left[\sin3x-\frac{1}{2}(\sin5x+\sin x)\right]dx$\\$=\left[-\frac{1}{6}\cos3x+\frac{1}{20}\cos5x+\frac{1}{4}\cos x\right]_0^{\pi/2}$\\$=\left[0-0-0\right]-\left[-\frac{1}{6}+\frac{1}{20}+\frac{1}{4}\right]=-\frac{8}{60}=\frac{2}{15}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/2}\sin^5\theta\cos^4\theta\,d\theta$
DetailedAnswer: (iv) $\int_0^{\pi/2}\sin^5\theta\cos^4\theta\,d\theta=-\int_0^{\pi/2}\sin^4\theta\cos^4\theta(-\sin\theta)d\theta$\\$=-\int_0^{\pi/2}(1-\cos^2\theta)^2\cos^4\theta(-\sin\theta)d\theta$\\ধরি, $z=\cos\theta$; $\therefore dz=-\sin\theta d\theta$। সীমা: $\theta=0$ হলে $z=1$ এবং $\theta=\frac{\pi}{2}$ হলে $z=0$।\\$=-\int_1^0(1-z^2)^2z^4dz=\int_0^1(z^4-2z^6+z^8)dz$\\$=\left[\frac{z^5}{5}-\frac{2z^7}{7}+\frac{z^9}{9}\right]_0^1=\frac{1}{5}-\frac{2}{7}+\frac{1}{9}=\frac{8}{315}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_{\pi/3}^{\pi/2}\frac{\cos^5x}{\sin^7x}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (v) মনে করি, $I=\int_{\pi/3}^{\pi/2}\frac{\cos^5x}{\sin^7x}dx=\int_{\pi/3}^{\pi/2}\cot^5x\cosec^2x\,dx$\\মনে করি, $z=\cot x$; $\therefore dz=-\cosec^2xdx$। সীমা: $x=\frac{\pi}{3}$ হলে $z=\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$ এবং $x=\frac{\pi}{2}$ হলে $z=0$।\\$\therefore I=\int_{1/\sqrt{3}}^0z^5(-dz)=\int_0^{1/\sqrt{3}}z^5dz$\\$=\frac{1}{6}[z^6]_0^{1/\sqrt{3}}=\frac{1}{6}\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right)^6=\frac{1}{162}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/4}(\tan^3x+\tan x)dx$
DetailedAnswer: (vi) $\int_0^{\pi/4}(\tan^3x+\tan x)dx=\int_0^{\pi/4}\tan x(1+\tan^2x)dx$\\$=\int_0^{\pi/4}\tan x\sec^2x\,dx$। মনে করি, $\tan x=z$; $\therefore \sec^2xdx=dz$।\\সীমা: $x=0$ হলে $z=0$ এবং $x=\frac{\pi}{4}$ হলে $z=1$।\\$=\int_0^1z\,dz=\left[\frac{z^2}{2}\right]_0^1=\frac{1}{2}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/2}\sin^5x\left(\sqrt{1-\sin^2x}\right)^4dx$
DetailedAnswer: (vii) $\int_0^{\pi/2}\sin^5x\left(\sqrt{1-\sin^2x}\right)^4dx=\int_0^{\pi/2}\sin^5x\cos^4x\,dx$\\$=-\int_0^{\pi/2}\sin^4x\cos^4x(-\sin x)dx$\\$=-\int_0^{\pi/2}(1-\cos^2x)^2\cos^4x(-\sin x)dx$\\ধরি, $z=\cos x$; $\therefore dz=-\sin xdx$। সীমা: $x=0$ হলে $z=1$ এবং $x=\frac{\pi}{2}$ হলে $z=0$।\\$=\int_0^1(z^4-2z^6+z^8)dz=\left[\frac{z^5}{5}-\frac{2z^7}{7}+\frac{z^9}{9}\right]_0^1$\\$=\frac{1}{5}-\frac{2}{7}+\frac{1}{9}=\frac{8}{315}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{\cos^3\theta}{\sqrt{\sin\theta}}d\theta$
DetailedAnswer: 9.(i) $\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{\cos^3\theta}{\sqrt{\sin\theta}}d\theta=\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{\cos^2\theta\cos\theta}{\sqrt{\sin\theta}}d\theta$\\$=\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{(1-\sin^2\theta)\cos\theta}{\sqrt{\sin\theta}}d\theta$। ধরি, $\sin\theta=z$; $\therefore \cos\theta d\theta=dz$।\\সীমা: $\theta=0$ হলে $z=0$ এবং $\theta=\frac{\pi}{2}$ হলে $z=1$।\\$=\int_0^1\left(z^{-1/2}-z^{3/2}\right)dz=\left[2z^{1/2}-\frac{2}{5}z^{5/2}\right]_0^1$\\$=2-\frac{2}{5}=\frac{8}{5}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/2}\sin^3x\sqrt{\cos x}\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (ii) ধরি, $I=\int_0^{\pi/2}\sin^3x\sqrt{\cos x}\,dx$\\$=\int_0^{\pi/2}\sqrt{\cos x}\sin^2x\sin x\,dx=\int_0^{\pi/2}\sqrt{\cos x}(1-\cos^2x)\sin x\,dx$\\আবার ধরি, $\cos x=z$; $\therefore \sin xdx=-dz$। সীমা: $x=0$ হলে $z=1$ এবং $x=\frac{\pi}{2}$ হলে $z=0$।\\$\therefore I=\int_1^0\sqrt{z}(1-z^2)(-dz)=-\int_1^0(z^{1/2}-z^{5/2})dz$\\$=\left[\frac{2}{3}z^{3/2}-\frac{2}{7}z^{7/2}\right]_0^1=\frac{2}{3}-\frac{2}{7}=\frac{8}{21}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/2}\cos^3x\sqrt{\sin x}\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (iii) $\int_0^{\pi/2}\cos^3x\sqrt{\sin x}\,dx=\int_0^{\pi/2}\cos^2x\sqrt{\sin x}\cos x\,dx$\\$=\int_0^{\pi/2}(1-\sin^2x)\sqrt{\sin x}\cos x\,dx$। ধরি, $z=\sin x$; $\therefore dz=\cos xdx$।\\সীমা: $x=0$ হলে $z=0$ এবং $x=\frac{\pi}{2}$ হলে $z=1$।\\$=\int_0^1(1-z^2)z^{1/2}dz=\int_0^1(z^{1/2}-z^{5/2})dz$\\$=\left[\frac{2}{3}z^{3/2}-\frac{2}{7}z^{7/2}\right]_0^1=\frac{2}{3}-\frac{2}{7}=\frac{8}{21}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\ln2}\frac{e^x}{1+e^x}dx$
DetailedAnswer: 10.(i) $\int_0^{\ln2}\frac{e^x}{1+e^x}dx$\\ধরি, $z=1+e^x$; $\therefore dz=e^xdx$। সীমা: $x=0$ হলে $z=2$ এবং $x=\ln2$ হলে $z=3$।\\$=\int_2^3\frac{dz}{z}=[\ln z]_2^3=\ln3-\ln2$\\$=\ln\frac{3}{2}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^1\frac{dx}{e^x+e^{-x}}$
DetailedAnswer: (ii) $\int_0^1\frac{dx}{e^x+e^{-x}}=\int_0^1\frac{e^xdx}{e^{2x}+1}$\\ধরি, $e^x=z$; $\therefore e^xdx=dz$। সীমা: $x=0$ হলে $z=1$ এবং $x=1$ হলে $z=e$।\\$=\int_1^e\frac{dz}{1+z^2}=[\tan^{-1}z]_1^e$\\$=\tan^{-1}e-\tan^{-1}1=\tan^{-1}e-\frac{\pi}{4}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\ln2}\frac{e^{2x}}{(1+e^{2x})^2}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (iii) প্রদত্ত রাশি $=\int_0^{\ln2}\frac{e^{2x}}{(1+e^{2x})^2}dx$\\ধরি, $z=1+e^{2x}$; $\therefore dz=2e^{2x}dx$ বা, $e^{2x}dx=\frac{dz}{2}$। সীমা: $x=0$ হলে $z=2$ এবং $x=\ln2$ হলে $z=5$।\\$=\int_2^5\frac{dz}{2z^2}=\frac{1}{2}\int_2^5\frac{1}{z^2}dz$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\left[-\frac{1}{z}\right]_2^5=-\frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{1}{5}-\frac{1}{2}\right)=\frac{3}{20}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^3\frac{xe^x}{(1+x)^2}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (iv) মনে করি, $I=\int_0^3\frac{xe^x}{(1+x)^2}dx$।\\$=\int_0^3e^x\left[\frac{1}{1+x}-\frac{1}{(1+x)^2}\right]dx$\\এখন, ধরি, $f(x)=\frac{1}{1+x}$; $\therefore f'(x)=-\frac{1}{(1+x)^2}$।\\আমরা জানি, $\int e^x\{f(x)+f'(x)\}dx=e^xf(x)+c$।\\$\therefore \int_0^3e^x\left[\frac{1}{1+x}-\frac{1}{(1+x)^2}\right]dx=\left[\frac{e^x}{1+x}\right]_0^3$\\$=\frac{e^3}{1+3}-\frac{e^0}{1+0}=\frac{e^3}{4}-1$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^4\sqrt{16-x^2}\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: 11.(i) $\int_0^4\sqrt{16-x^2}\,dx$\\মনে করি, $x=4\sin\theta$; $\therefore dx=4\cos\theta d\theta$ এবং $\sqrt{16-x^2}=4\cos\theta$। সীমা: $x=0$ হলে $\theta=0$ এবং $x=4$ হলে $\theta=\frac{\pi}{2}$।\\$\therefore \int_0^4\sqrt{16-x^2}dx=\int_0^{\pi/2}4\cos\theta\cdot4\cos\theta d\theta$\\$=8\int_0^{\pi/2}2\cos^2\theta d\theta=8\int_0^{\pi/2}(1+\cos2\theta)d\theta$\\$=8\left[\theta+\frac{1}{2}\sin2\theta\right]_0^{\pi/2}=8\cdot\frac{\pi}{2}=4\pi$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_{-1}^1x^2\sqrt{4-x^2}\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (iii) মনে করি, $I=\int_{-1}^1x^2\sqrt{4-x^2}dx$। ধরি, $x=2\sin\theta$; $\therefore dx=2\cos\theta d\theta$। সীমা: $x=-1$ হলে $\theta=-\frac{\pi}{6}$ এবং $x=1$ হলে $\theta=\frac{\pi}{6}$।\\$\therefore I=\int_{-\pi/6}^{\pi/6}4\sin^2\theta\sqrt{4-4\sin^2\theta}\cdot2\cos\theta d\theta$\\$=\int_{-\pi/6}^{\pi/6}16\sin^2\theta\cos^2\theta d\theta=4\int_{-\pi/6}^{\pi/6}(2\sin\theta\cos\theta)^2d\theta$\\$=4\int_{-\pi/6}^{\pi/6}\sin^2 2\theta d\theta=2\int_{-\pi/6}^{\pi/6}(1-\cos4\theta)d\theta$\\$=2\left[\theta-\frac{\sin4\theta}{4}\right]_{-\pi/6}^{\pi/6}$\\$=2\left[\frac{\pi}{6}-\frac{1}{4}\sin\frac{2\pi}{3}+\frac{\pi}{6}+\frac{1}{4}\sin\left(-\frac{2\pi}{3}\right)\right]$\\$=2\left[\frac{\pi}{3}-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{8}-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{8}\right]=\frac{2\pi}{3}-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^4y\sqrt{4-y}\,dy$
$\int_0^{2a}\sqrt{2ax-x^2}\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (v) $\int_0^{2a}\sqrt{2ax-x^2}dx=\int_0^{2a}\sqrt{a^2-(x-a)^2}dx$\\$=\left[\frac{(x-a)\sqrt{a^2-(x-a)^2}}{2}+\frac{a^2}{2}\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{x-a}{a}\right)\right]_0^{2a}$\\$=\left\{0+\frac{a^2}{2}\sin^{-1}(1)\right\}-\left\{0+\frac{a^2}{2}\sin^{-1}(-1)\right\}$\\$=\frac{a^2}{2}\cdot\frac{\pi}{2}+\frac{a^2}{2}\cdot\frac{\pi}{2}=\frac{\pi a^2}{2}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^3\frac{dx}{\sqrt{3x-x^2}}$
DetailedAnswer: (vi) $\int_0^3\frac{dx}{\sqrt{3x-x^2}}=\int_0^3\frac{dx}{\sqrt{\frac{9}{4}-\left(x-\frac{3}{2}\right)^2}}$\\$=\left[\sin^{-1}\frac{x-\frac{3}{2}}{\frac{3}{2}}\right]_0^3$\\$=\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{3}{2}\cdot\frac{2}{3}\right)-\sin^{-1}(-1)$\\$=2\sin^{-1}1=2\cdot\frac{\pi}{2}=\pi$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^8x^2\sqrt{64-x^2}\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (vii) প্রদত্ত রাশি $=\int_0^8x^2\sqrt{64-x^2}dx$। ধরি, $x=8\sin\theta$; $\therefore dx=8\cos\theta d\theta$। সীমা: $x=0$ হলে $\theta=0$ এবং $x=8$ হলে $\theta=\frac{\pi}{2}$।\\$=\int_0^{\pi/2}(8\sin\theta)^2\sqrt{64-(8\sin\theta)^2}\cdot8\cos\theta d\theta$\\$=\int_0^{\pi/2}64\sin^2\theta\cdot8\cos\theta\cdot8\cos\theta d\theta$\\$=4096\int_0^{\pi/2}\sin^2\theta\cos^2\theta d\theta=1024\int_0^{\pi/2}\sin^2 2\theta d\theta$\\$=512\int_0^{\pi/2}(1-\cos4\theta)d\theta=512\left[\theta-\frac{\sin4\theta}{4}\right]_0^{\pi/2}$\\$=512\cdot\frac{\pi}{2}=256\pi$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_{-2}^2x^2\sqrt{16-x^2}\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (viii) প্রদত্ত যোগজ $=\int_{-2}^2x^2\sqrt{16-x^2}dx$। ধরি, $x=4\sin\theta$; $\therefore dx=4\cos\theta d\theta$। সীমা: $x=-2$ হলে $\theta=-\frac{\pi}{6}$ এবং $x=2$ হলে $\theta=\frac{\pi}{6}$।\\$I=\int_{-\pi/6}^{\pi/6}16\sin^2\theta\sqrt{16-16\sin^2\theta}\cdot4\cos\theta d\theta$\\$=\int_{-\pi/6}^{\pi/6}256\sin^2\theta\cos^2\theta d\theta=64\int_{-\pi/6}^{\pi/6}\sin^2 2\theta d\theta$\\$=32\int_{-\pi/6}^{\pi/6}(1-\cos4\theta)d\theta=32\left[\theta-\frac{\sin4\theta}{4}\right]_{-\pi/6}^{\pi/6}$\\$=32\left[\frac{\pi}{3}-\frac{1}{4}\cdot\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}-\frac{1}{4}\cdot\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right]$\\$=\frac{32\pi}{3}-8\sqrt{3}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\sqrt{2}}\frac{x^2}{(4-x^2)^{3/2}}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (ix) ধরি, $I=\int_0^{\sqrt{2}}\frac{x^2}{(4-x^2)^{3/2}}dx$। মনে করি, $x=2\sin\theta$; $\therefore dx=2\cos\theta d\theta$। সীমা: $x=0$ হলে $\theta=0$ এবং $x=\sqrt{2}$ হলে $\theta=\frac{\pi}{4}$।\\$I=\int_0^{\pi/4}\frac{4\sin^2\theta\cdot2\cos\theta d\theta}{\{4(1-\sin^2\theta)\}^{3/2}}$\\$=\int_0^{\pi/4}\frac{8\sin^2\theta\cos\theta}{8\cos^3\theta}d\theta=\int_0^{\pi/4}\tan^2\theta d\theta$\\$=\int_0^{\pi/4}(\sec^2\theta-1)d\theta=[\tan\theta-\theta]_0^{\pi/4}$\\$=\tan\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\pi}{4}-(\tan0-0)=1-\frac{\pi}{4}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_1^4\ln x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: 12.(i) ধরি, $I=\int_1^4\ln x\,dx$।\\এখন, $\int\ln x\,dx=\ln x\int dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(\ln x)\int dx\right\}dx$\\$=x\ln x-\int\frac{1}{x}\cdot x\,dx=x\ln x-\int dx=x\ln x-x+c$।\\$\therefore I=[x\ln x-x]_1^4=4\ln4-4-1\cdot\ln1+1=4\ln4-3$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^1\ln x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (ii) ধরি, $I=\int_0^1\ln x\,dx$।\\$\int\ln x\,dx=x\ln x-x+c$।\\$\therefore \int_0^1\ln x\,dx=[x\ln x-x]_0^1=0-1-0+0=-1$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^1\ln(x^2+1)dx$
DetailedAnswer: (iii) ধরি, $I=\int_0^1\ln(x^2+1)dx$।\\এখন, $\int\ln(x^2+1)dx=\ln(x^2+1)\int dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}\ln(x^2+1)\int dx\right\}dx$\\$=x\ln(x^2+1)-\int\frac{2x}{x^2+1}\cdot x\,dx$\\$=x\ln(x^2+1)-2\int\left(1-\frac{1}{1+x^2}\right)dx$\\$=x\ln(x^2+1)-2(x-\tan^{-1}x)+c$\\$=x\ln(x^2+1)-2x+2\tan^{-1}x+c$।\\$\therefore I=[x\ln(x^2+1)-2x+2\tan^{-1}x]_0^1$\\$=\ln2-2+2\tan^{-1}1=\ln2-2+\frac{\pi}{2}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_1^4\frac{\ln x}{\sqrt{x}}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (iv) $\int_1^4\frac{\ln x}{\sqrt{x}}dx=I$ (ধরি)।\\এখন, $\int\frac{\ln x}{\sqrt{x}}dx=\ln x\int x^{-1/2}dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(\ln x)\int x^{-1/2}dx\right\}dx$\\$=2\ln x\sqrt{x}-\int\frac{1}{x}\cdot2\sqrt{x}\,dx$\\$=2\ln x\sqrt{x}-2\int x^{-1/2}dx=2\ln x\sqrt{x}-4\sqrt{x}$।\\$\therefore I=[2\ln x\sqrt{x}-4\sqrt{x}]_1^4$\\$=2\ln4\sqrt{4}-4\sqrt{4}-0+4\cdot1=4\ln4-4=8\ln2-4$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_1^2\ln2x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (v) প্রদত্ত যোগজ $=\int_1^2\ln2x\,dx$।\\এখানে, $\int\ln2x\,dx=\ln2x\int dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(\ln2x)\int dx\right\}dx$\\$=x\ln2x-\int\frac{2}{2x}\cdot xdx=x\ln2x-\int dx=x\ln2x-x+c$।\\$\therefore \int_1^2\ln2x\,dx=[x\ln2x-x]_1^2$\\$=2\ln(2\cdot2)-2-\ln2-1=2\ln4-\ln2-1$\\$=\ln8-1=3\ln2-1$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^1 xe^{-3x}dx$
DetailedAnswer: 13.(i) $\int xe^{-3x}dx=x\int e^{-3x}dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(x)\int e^{-3x}dx\right\}dx$\\$=x\left(\frac{e^{-3x}}{-3}\right)-\int\frac{e^{-3x}}{-3}dx$\\$=-\frac{1}{3}xe^{-3x}+\frac{1}{3}\int e^{-3x}dx$\\$=-\frac{1}{3}xe^{-3x}+\frac{1}{3}\left(\frac{e^{-3x}}{-3}\right)=-\frac{1}{3}e^{-3x}\left(x+\frac{1}{3}\right)+c$।\\$\therefore \int_0^1xe^{-3x}dx=\left[-\frac{1}{3}e^{-3x}\left(x+\frac{1}{3}\right)\right]_0^1$\\$=-\frac{1}{3}e^{-3}\left(1+\frac{1}{3}\right)+\frac{1}{3}e^0\left(0+\frac{1}{3}\right)=\frac{1}{9}(1-4e^{-3})$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/2}x^2\cos x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (ii) ধরি, $I=\int_0^{\pi/2}x^2\cos xdx$।\\এখন, $\int x^2\cos xdx=x^2\int\cos xdx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(x^2)\int\cos xdx\right\}dx$\\$=x^2\sin x-2\int x\sin xdx$\\$=x^2\sin x-2\left[x\int\sin xdx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(x)\int\sin xdx\right\}dx\right]$\\$=x^2\sin x-2[-x\cos x+\int\cos xdx]$\\$=x^2\sin x+2x\cos x-2\sin x+c$।\\$\therefore I=[x^2\sin x+2x\cos x-2\sin x]_0^{\pi/2}$\\$=\frac{\pi^2}{4}-2$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^1\sin^{-1}x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (iii) ধরি, $I=\int_0^1\sin^{-1}x\,dx$।\\এখন, $\int\sin^{-1}x\,dx=\sin^{-1}x\int dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(\sin^{-1}x)\int dx\right\}dx$\\$=x\sin^{-1}x-\int\frac{x}{\sqrt{1-x^2}}dx=x\sin^{-1}x+\sqrt{1-x^2}$।\\$\therefore I=[x\sin^{-1}x+\sqrt{1-x^2}]_0^1$\\$=\sin^{-1}1+0-0-1=\frac{\pi}{2}-1$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_1^{\sqrt{3}}x\tan^{-1}x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (iv) এখানে, $\int x\tan^{-1}x\,dx=\tan^{-1}x\int xdx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(\tan^{-1}x)\int xdx\right\}dx$\\$=\frac{1}{2}x^2\tan^{-1}x-\frac{1}{2}\int\frac{x^2}{1+x^2}dx$\\$=\frac{1}{2}x^2\tan^{-1}x-\frac{1}{2}\int\left(1-\frac{1}{1+x^2}\right)dx$\\$=\frac{1}{2}x^2\tan^{-1}x-\frac{1}{2}x+\frac{1}{2}\tan^{-1}x+c$।\\$\therefore \int_1^{\sqrt{3}}x\tan^{-1}x\,dx=\left[\frac{1}{2}x^2\tan^{-1}x-\frac{1}{2}x+\frac{1}{2}\tan^{-1}x\right]_1^{\sqrt{3}}$\\$=\left(\frac{2\pi}{3}-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)-\left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{1}{2}\right)=\frac{5\pi}{12}-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}+\frac{1}{2}$\\$=\frac{1}{12}(5\pi-6\sqrt{3}+6)$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^\pi x\cos^4x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (v) ধরি, $I=\int x\cos^4x\,dx$।\\এখন, $\int\cos^4x\,dx=\frac{1}{4}\int(2\cos^2x)^2dx=\frac{1}{4}\int(1+\cos2x)^2dx$\\$=\frac{1}{4}\int(1+2\cos2x+\cos^2 2x)dx=\frac{3x}{8}+\frac{\sin2x}{4}+\frac{\sin4x}{32}$।\\$\therefore I=x\left(\frac{3x}{8}+\frac{\sin2x}{4}+\frac{\sin4x}{32}\right)-\int\left(\frac{3x}{8}+\frac{\sin2x}{4}+\frac{\sin4x}{32}\right)dx$\\$=\frac{3x^2}{16}+\frac{x\sin2x}{4}+\frac{x\sin4x}{32}+\frac{\cos2x}{8}+\frac{\cos4x}{128}+c$।\\$\therefore \int_0^\pi x\cos^4x\,dx=\left[\frac{3x^2}{16}+\frac{x\sin2x}{4}+\frac{x\sin4x}{32}+\frac{\cos2x}{8}+\frac{\cos4x}{128}\right]_0^\pi$\\$=\frac{3\pi^2}{16}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_1^{\sqrt{3}}x\cot^{-1}x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: (vi) প্রদত্ত রাশি $=\int_1^{\sqrt{3}}x\cot^{-1}x\,dx$।\\$\int x\cot^{-1}x\,dx=\cot^{-1}x\int xdx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(\cot^{-1}x)\int xdx\right\}dx$\\$=\frac{x^2}{2}\cot^{-1}x+\frac{1}{2}\int\frac{x^2}{1+x^2}dx$\\$=\frac{x^2}{2}\cot^{-1}x+\frac{1}{2}\int dx-\frac{1}{2}\int\frac{dx}{1+x^2}$\\$=\frac{x^2}{2}\cot^{-1}x+\frac{x}{2}-\frac{1}{2}\tan^{-1}x+c$।\\$\therefore \int_1^{\sqrt{3}}x\cot^{-1}x\,dx=\left[\frac{x^2}{2}\cot^{-1}x+\frac{x}{2}-\frac{1}{2}\tan^{-1}x\right]_1^{\sqrt{3}}$\\$=\left(\frac{3}{2}\cdot\frac{\pi}{6}+\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}-\frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{\pi}{3}\right)-\left(\frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{\pi}{4}+\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{\pi}{4}\right)$\\$=\frac{\pi}{12}+\frac{\sqrt{3}-1}{2}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^12x^3e^{-x^2}dx$
DetailedAnswer: 14. $\int_0^12x^3e^{-x^2}dx=\int_0^12x\cdot x^2e^{-x^2}dx$\\মনে করি, $x^2=z$; $\therefore 2xdx=dz$। সীমা: $x=0$ হলে $z=0$ এবং $x=1$ হলে $z=1$।\\এখন, $\int_0^1ze^{-z}dz=z\int e^{-z}dz-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dz}(z)\int e^{-z}dz\right\}dz$\\$=-ze^{-z}+\int e^{-z}dz=-ze^{-z}-e^{-z}+c$।\\$\therefore \int_0^1ze^{-z}dz=[-ze^{-z}-e^{-z}]_0^1=e^{-0}-\frac{2}{e}=1-\frac{2}{e}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/2}e^x(\sin x+\cos x)dx$
DetailedAnswer: 15. মনে করি, $I=\int e^x(\sin x+\cos x)dx$\\$=\int e^x\sin xdx+\int e^x\cos xdx$\\$=\sin x\int e^xdx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(\sin x)\int e^xdx\right\}dx+\int e^x\cos xdx$\\$=e^x\sin x-\int e^x\cos xdx+\int e^x\cos xdx=e^x\sin x+c$।\\অতএব, $\int_0^{\pi/2}e^x(\sin x+\cos x)dx=[e^x\sin x]_0^{\pi/2}=e^{\pi/2}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{d\theta}{a\sin^2\theta+b\cos^2\theta}$
DetailedAnswer: 16.(i) $\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{d\theta}{a\sin^2\theta+b\cos^2\theta}=\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{\sec^2\theta\,d\theta}{a\tan^2\theta+b}$।\\ধরি, $\sqrt{a}\tan\theta=z$; $\therefore \sqrt{a}\sec^2\theta d\theta=dz$। সীমা: $\theta=0$ হলে $z=0$ এবং $\theta=\frac{\pi}{2}$ হলে $z=\infty$।\\$=\frac{1}{\sqrt{a}}\int_0^\infty\frac{dz}{(\sqrt{b})^2+z^2}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{a}}\left[\frac{1}{\sqrt{b}}\tan^{-1}\frac{z}{\sqrt{b}}\right]_0^\infty$\\$=\frac{1}{\sqrt{a}\sqrt{b}}\cdot\frac{\pi}{2}=\frac{\pi}{2\sqrt{ab}}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/4}\frac{\sin2x}{\cos^4x+\sin^4x}dx$
DetailedAnswer: (ii) ধরি, $I=\int_0^{\pi/4}\frac{\sin2x}{\cos^4x+\sin^4x}dx$\\$=\int_0^{\pi/4}\frac{2\sin x\cos x}{\cos^4x+\sin^4x}dx=\int_0^{\pi/4}\frac{2\tan x\sec^2x}{1+\tan^4x}dx$।\\ধরি, $\tan^2x=z$; $\therefore 2\tan x\sec^2xdx=dz$।\\$I=\int_0^1\frac{dz}{1+z^2}=[\tan^{-1}z]_0^1=\tan^{-1}1-\tan^{-1}0=\frac{\pi}{4}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{dx}{1+\cot x}$
DetailedAnswer: 17. $\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{dx}{1+\cot x}=\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{\sin x}{\cos x+\sin x}dx$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{\sin x+\cos x-\cos x+\sin x}{\cos x+\sin x}dx$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\int_0^{\pi/2}dx-\frac{1}{2}\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{-\sin x+\cos x}{\cos x+\sin x}dx$\\$=\frac{1}{2}[x]_0^{\pi/2}-\frac{1}{2}[\ln(\cos x+\sin x)]_0^{\pi/2}$\\$=\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{1}{2}(\ln1-\ln1)=\frac{\pi}{4}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^\pi\frac{x\,dx}{1+\sin x}$
DetailedAnswer: 18. ধরি, $I=\int_0^\pi\frac{x\,dx}{1+\sin x}$\\$=\int_0^\pi\frac{x(1-\sin x)dx}{1-\sin^2x}=\int_0^\pi\frac{x-x\sin x}{\cos^2x}dx$\\$=\int_0^\pi(x\sec^2x-x\sec x\tan x)dx$।\\এখন, $\int(x\sec^2x-x\sec x\tan x)dx=x\int\sec^2x\,dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(x)\int\sec^2x\,dx\right\}dx-\left[x\int\sec x\tan xdx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(x)\int\sec x\tan xdx\right\}dx\right]$\\$=x\tan x-\int\tan xdx-x\sec x+\int\sec xdx$\\$=x\tan x-\ln|\sec x|-x\sec x+\ln|\sec x+\tan x|$।\\$\therefore I=[x\tan x-\ln|\sec x|-x\sec x+\ln|\sec x+\tan x|]_0^\pi=\pi$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_1^2\frac{dx}{x^2\sqrt{4-x^2}}$
DetailedAnswer: (ii) ধরি, $I=\int_1^2\frac{dx}{x^2\sqrt{4-x^2}}$। মনে করি, $x=2\cos\theta$; $dx=-2\sin\theta d\theta$। সীমা: $x=1$ হলে $\theta=\frac{\pi}{3}$ এবং $x=2$ হলে $\theta=0$।\\$\therefore I=\int_{\pi/3}^0\frac{-2\sin\theta d\theta}{4\cos^2\theta\sqrt{4(1-\cos^2\theta)}}$\\$=-\frac{1}{4}\int_{\pi/3}^0\sec^2\theta d\theta=-\frac{1}{4}[\tan\theta]_{\pi/3}^0$\\$=-\frac{1}{4}(\tan0-\tan\frac{\pi}{3})=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{\sqrt{\cos x}}{\sqrt{\sin x}+\sqrt{\cos x}}dx$
DetailedAnswer: 21.(i) ধরি, $I=\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{\sqrt{\cos x}}{\sqrt{\sin x}+\sqrt{\cos x}}dx$।\\$=\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{\sqrt{\cos(\frac{\pi}{2}-x)}}{\sqrt{\sin(\frac{\pi}{2}-x)}+\sqrt{\cos(\frac{\pi}{2}-x)}}dx$\\$=\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{\sqrt{\sin x}}{\sqrt{\cos x}+\sqrt{\sin x}}dx$।\\দুটি সমীকরণ যোগ করে, $2I=\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{\sqrt{\cos x}+\sqrt{\sin x}}{\sqrt{\sin x}+\sqrt{\cos x}}dx=\int_0^{\pi/2}dx$\\$=[x]_0^{\pi/2}=\frac{\pi}{2}$।\\$\therefore I=\frac{\pi}{4}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_{-\pi/4}^{\pi/4}\frac{\sec^6x-\tan^6x}{(a^x+1)\cos^2x}dx\;(a>0)$
DetailedAnswer: (ii) ধরি, $I=\int_{-\pi/4}^{\pi/4}\frac{\sec^6x-\tan^6x}{(a^x+1)\cos^2x}dx\;(a>0)$।\\$=\int_{-\pi/4}^0\frac{\sec^6x-\tan^6x}{(a^x+1)\cos^2x}dx+\int_0^{\pi/4}\frac{\sec^6x-\tan^6x}{(a^x+1)\cos^2x}dx=I_1+I_2$।\\$I_1$-এ $x=-y$ বসালে, $dx=-dy$ এবং $I_1=\int_0^{\pi/4}\frac{\sec^6y-\tan^6y}{(a^{-y}+1)\cos^2y}dy$\\$=\int_0^{\pi/4}\frac{a^x(\sec^6x-\tan^6x)}{(a^x+1)\cos^2x}dx$।\\$\therefore I=\int_0^{\pi/4}\left(\frac{a^x}{a^x+1}+\frac{1}{a^x+1}\right)\frac{\sec^6x-\tan^6x}{\cos^2x}dx$\\$=\int_0^{\pi/4}\frac{(1+\tan^2x)^3-\tan^6x}{\cos^2x}dx$\\$=\int_0^{\pi/4}(1+3\tan^2x+3\tan^4x)\sec^2x\,dx$\\$=\left[\tan x+\tan^3x+\frac{3}{5}\tan^5x\right]_0^{\pi/4}$\\$=1+1+\frac{3}{5}=\frac{13}{5}$ (Ans.)

Question: Type-VIII. 22.(ii) $\int_{-\pi/2}^{\pi/2}|\sin x|dx$
DetailedAnswer: (ii) $\int_{-\pi/2}^{\pi/2}|\sin x|dx$\\$\sin x=0$ যখন $x=0$। $-\frac{\pi}{2}\le x<0$ এর জন্য $\sin x<0$; $\therefore |\sin x|=-\sin x$। $0<x\le\frac{\pi}{2}$ এর জন্য $\sin x>0$; $\therefore |\sin x|=\sin x$।\\$\therefore \int_{-\pi/2}^{\pi/2}|\sin x|dx=\int_{-\pi/2}^0-\sin xdx+\int_0^{\pi/2}\sin xdx$\\$=[\cos x]_{-\pi/2}^0+[-\cos x]_0^{\pi/2}$\\$=\cos0-\cos\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}\right)-\left(\cos\frac{\pi}{2}-\cos0\right)=1+1=2$ (Ans.)

Question: Type-VIII. 22.(iii) $\int_0^{\pi/2}|\cos2x|dx$
DetailedAnswer: (iii) $\int_0^{\pi/2}|\cos2x|dx$\\$\cos2x=0$ যখন $2x=\frac{\pi}{2}$ বা, $x=\frac{\pi}{4}$। $0\le x<\frac{\pi}{4}$ এর জন্য $\cos2x>0$ এবং $\frac{\pi}{4}<x\le\frac{\pi}{2}$ এর জন্য $\cos2x<0$।\\$\therefore \int_0^{\pi/2}|\cos2x|dx=\int_0^{\pi/4}\cos2x\,dx+\int_{\pi/4}^{\pi/2}(-\cos2x)dx$\\$=\left[\frac{\sin2x}{2}\right]_0^{\pi/4}-\left[\frac{\sin2x}{2}\right]_{\pi/4}^{\pi/2}$\\$=\frac{1}{2}(1-0)-\frac{1}{2}(0-1)=1$ (Ans.)

Question: Type-VIII. 22.(iv) $\int_{-1}^1|x|dx$
Type-VIII. 22.(v) $\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}|\cos x|dx$
Type-VIII. 22.(vi) $\int_{-2}^6|x-1|dx$
Type-VIII. 22.(vii) $\int_0^{2\pi}\{|\sin x|+|\cos x|\}dx$
Type-VIII. 22.(viii) $\int_{-\pi/4}^{n\pi-\pi/4}|\sin x+\cos x|dx$
DetailedAnswer: (viii) $\int_{-\pi/4}^{n\pi-\pi/4}|\sin x+\cos x|dx$\\$=\sqrt{2}\int_{-\pi/4}^{n\pi-\pi/4}\left|\sin x\cdot\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}+\cos x\cdot\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\right|dx$\\$=\sqrt{2}\int_{-\pi/4}^{n\pi-\pi/4}\left|\sin\left(x+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)\right|dx$।\\ধরি, $x+\frac{\pi}{4}=z$; $\therefore dx=dz$। সীমা: $x=-\frac{\pi}{4}$ হলে $z=0$ এবং $x=n\pi-\frac{\pi}{4}$ হলে $z=n\pi$।\\$=\sqrt{2}\int_0^{n\pi}|\sin z|dz=\sqrt{2}\cdot2n=2\sqrt{2}\,n$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^\pi x\sin^2x\,dx$
DetailedAnswer: 23. $\int_0^\pi x\sin^2x\,dx$\\এখন, $\int x\sin^2x\,dx=\frac{1}{2}\int x\cdot2\sin^2x\,dx=\frac{1}{2}\int x(1-\cos2x)dx$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\left[\frac{x^2}{2}-\int x\cos2x\,dx\right]$\\$=\frac{x^2}{4}-\frac{1}{2}\left[x\int\cos2x\,dx-\int\left\{\frac{d}{dx}(x)\int\cos2x\,dx\right\}dx\right]$\\$=\frac{x^2}{4}-\frac{1}{2}\left[x\frac{\sin2x}{2}-\frac{1}{2}\int\sin2x\,dx\right]$\\$=\frac{1}{4}(x^2-x\sin2x-\frac{1}{2}\cos2x)+c$।\\$\therefore \int_0^\pi x\sin^2x\,dx=\left[\frac{1}{4}(x^2-x\sin2x-\frac{1}{2}\cos2x)\right]_0^\pi=\frac{1}{4}\pi^2$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/6}\frac{dx}{1-\tan^2x}$
DetailedAnswer: 25. $\int_0^{\pi/6}\frac{dx}{1-\tan^2x}=\int_0^{\pi/6}\frac{\cos^2x\,dx}{\cos^2x-\sin^2x}$\\$=\int_0^{\pi/6}\frac{\frac{1}{2}(1+\cos2x)}{\cos2x}dx=\frac{1}{2}\int_0^{\pi/6}(\sec2x+1)dx$\\$=\frac{1}{2}\left[\frac{1}{2}\ln|\tan2x+\sec2x|+x\right]_0^{\pi/6}$\\$=\frac{1}{4}\ln|\tan\frac{\pi}{3}+\sec\frac{\pi}{3}|+\frac{\pi}{12}$\\$=\frac{1}{4}\ln(\sqrt{3}+2)+\frac{\pi}{12}$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_0^{\pi/2}\sin^5x\,dx$
$\int_2^3\frac{dx}{(x-1)\sqrt{x^2-2x}}$
$f(x)=x+1$ এবং $g(x)=\frac{(f(x)-1)e^x}{(f(x))^2}$ হলে, $\int_0^1g(x)dx$
DetailedAnswer: 30. দেওয়া আছে, $f(x)=x+1$ এবং $g(x)=\frac{(f(x)-1)e^x}{(f(x))^2}$\\$\therefore g(x)=\frac{xe^x}{(x+1)^2}=e^x\frac{x}{(x+1)^2}$\\$=e^x\left(\frac{1}{x+1}-\frac{1}{(x+1)^2}\right)$।\\$\therefore \int_0^1g(x)dx=\int_0^1e^x\left\{\frac{1}{x+1}-\frac{1}{(x+1)^2}\right\}dx$\\$=\left[\frac{e^x}{x+1}\right]_0^1=\frac{e}{2}-1$ (Ans.)

Question: $\int_2^e\left[\frac{1}{\log x}-\frac{1}{(\log x)^2}\right]dx$
DetailedAnswer: 31. $\int_2^e\left[\frac{1}{\log x}-\frac{1}{(\log x)^2}\right]dx$\\ধরি, $\log x=z$; $\therefore x=e^z,\;dx=e^zdz$। সীমা: $x=2$ হলে $z=\log2$ এবং $x=e$ হলে $z=1$।\\$=\int_{\log2}^1e^z\left(\frac{1}{z}-\frac{1}{z^2}\right)dz$\\$=\left[\frac{e^z}{z}\right]_{\log2}^1=e-\frac{e^{\log2}}{\log2}$\\$=e-\frac{2}{\log2}$ (Ans.)

Question: দেখাও যে, $\int_{-1}^1x^3\cos x\,dx=0$
DetailedAnswer: 32. $\int x^3\cos xdx=x^3\int\cos xdx-\int3x^2\sin xdx$\\$=x^3\sin x-3\int x^2\sin xdx$\\$=x^3\sin x-3[x^2(-\cos x)-\int2x(-\cos x)dx]+c''$\\$=x^3\sin x+3x^2\cos x-6\int x\cos xdx+c''$\\$=x^3\sin x+3x^2\cos x-6[x\sin x-\int\sin xdx]+c''$\\$=x^3\sin x+3x^2\cos x-6x\sin x-6\cos x+c''$।\\$\therefore \int_{-1}^1x^3\cos xdx=[x^3\sin x+3x^2\cos x-6x\sin x-6\cos x]_{-1}^1$\\$=[\sin1+3\cos1-6\sin1-6\cos1]-[-\sin(-1)+3\cos(-1)+6\sin(-1)-6\cos(-1)]$\\$=(-5\sin1-3\cos1)-(-5\sin1-3\cos1)=0$ (দেখানো হলো)

Question: দেখাও যে, $\int_a^b\frac{f(x)dx}{f(a+b-x)+f(x)}=\frac{b-a}{2}$
DetailedAnswer: 33. ধরি, $y=\int_a^b\frac{f(x)dx}{f(a+b-x)+f(x)}$\\$=\int_a^b\frac{f(a+b-x)dx}{f(a+b-x)+f(x)}$।\\এখন, $\int_a^b\frac{f(x)}{f(a+b-x)+f(x)}dx+\int_a^b\frac{f(a+b-x)}{f(a+b-x)+f(x)}dx=y+y$\\$\Rightarrow \int_a^b\frac{f(x)+f(a+b-x)}{f(a+b-x)+f(x)}dx=2y$\\$\Rightarrow \int_a^bdx=2y\Rightarrow [x]_a^b=2y$\\$\Rightarrow 2y=b-a$। $\therefore y=\frac{b-a}{2}$ (দেখানো হলো)

Question: $x$-অক্ষের সাথে $y=\sin x$ রেখা এবং $x=\frac{\pi}{2}$ সরলরেখা দ্বারা আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর।
DetailedAnswer: 1.(i) নির্ণেয় ক্ষেত্রফল, $A=\left[x=0,\;x=\frac{\pi}{2},\;y=\sin x\right]$ এবং $x$ অক্ষ দ্বারা আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল।\\$\therefore A=\int_0^{\pi/2}y\,dx=\int_0^{\pi/2}\sin x\,dx=[-\cos x]_0^{\pi/2}$\\$=-\left[\cos\frac{\pi}{2}-\cos0\right]=1$ বর্গ একক। (Ans.)

Question: $y=x^3$, $x$-অক্ষ এবং $x=2$ ও $x=3$ রেখা দ্বারা আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর।
DetailedAnswer: (ii) $x=2$, $x=3$, $y=x^3$ এবং $x$-অক্ষ দ্বারা আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল $=\int_2^3ydx=\int_2^3x^3dx$\\$=\left[\frac{x^4}{4}\right]_2^3=\frac{1}{4}(3^4-2^4)=\frac{65}{4}$ বর্গ একক। (Ans.)

Question: $y=x^2$, $x$-অক্ষ $(y=0)$ এবং $x=2$ ও $x=4$ রেখা দ্বারা আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর।
DetailedAnswer: (iii) প্রদত্ত রেখাচতুষ্টয় $y=x^2,\;y=0,\;x=2,\;x=4$।\\(ii) ও (iii) এবং (iv) রেখাগুলোর ছেদবিন্দুর স্থানাঙ্ক যথাক্রমে $(2,0)$ এবং $(4,0)$।\\নির্ণেয় ক্ষেত্রফল $=\int_2^4ydx=\int_2^4x^2dx=\left[\frac{x^3}{3}\right]_2^4$\\$=\frac{64}{3}-\frac{8}{3}=\frac{56}{3}$ বর্গ একক। (Ans.)

Question: $y=\cos x$ ফাংশনটি দ্বারা $x$ অক্ষের সাথে আবদ্ধ একটি চাপের ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর।
DetailedAnswer: (iv) $y=\cos x$; $y=0$ হলে, $\cos x=0$।\\$x=\cos^{-1}0=-\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{\pi}{2}$। অতএব $-\frac{\pi}{2}$ থেকে $\frac{\pi}{2}$ পর্যন্ত $y=\cos x$ একটি চাপ তৈরি করে।\\$\therefore$ ক্ষেত্রফল $=\int_{-\pi/2}^{\pi/2}\cos xdx=2\int_0^{\pi/2}\cos xdx$ [যেহেতু $\cos x$ জোড় ফাংশন]\\$=2[\sin x]_0^{\pi/2}=2\{\sin\frac{\pi}{2}-\sin0\}=2$ বর্গ একক। (Ans.)

Question: $y=\sin^{-1}x$, $|y|=\frac{\pi}{2}$ এবং $x=0$ দ্বারা আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর।
DetailedAnswer: (v) দেওয়া আছে, $y=\sin^{-1}x$। $\therefore x=\sin y$।\\আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রফল $=2\int_0^{\pi/2}xdy=2\int_0^{\pi/2}\sin y\,dy$\\$=2[-\cos y]_0^{\pi/2}=2[0+1]=2$ বর্গ একক। (Ans.)

Question: $x^2+y^2=4$ বৃত্তের ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর।
DetailedAnswer: 2.(i) নির্ণেয় ক্ষেত্রফল $=4\times(y=\sqrt{4-x^2}$, $x$ অক্ষ এবং রেখা $x=0$ ও $x=2$ দ্বারা আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল)\\$=4\int_0^2ydx=4\int_0^2\sqrt{4-x^2}\,dx$।\\ধরি, $x=2\sin\theta$; $\therefore dx=2\cos\theta d\theta$। সীমা: $x=0$ হলে $\theta=0$ এবং $x=2$ হলে $\theta=\frac{\pi}{2}$।\\$=4\int_0^{\pi/2}\sqrt{4-4\sin^2\theta}\cdot2\cos\theta d\theta$\\$=4\cdot4\int_0^{\pi/2}\cos^2\theta d\theta=8\int_0^{\pi/2}2\cos^2\theta d\theta$\\$=8\int_0^{\pi/2}(1+\cos2\theta)d\theta=8\left[\theta+\frac{1}{2}\sin2\theta\right]_0^{\pi/2}=4\pi$ বর্গ একক। (Ans.)

Question: $x^2+y^2=16$ দ্বারা আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর।
DetailedAnswer: 2.(ii)(a) নির্ণেয় ক্ষেত্রফল $=4\times(y=\sqrt{16-x^2}$, $x$-অক্ষ এবং রেখা $x=0$ ও $x=4$ দ্বারা আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল)\\$=4\int_0^4ydx=4\int_0^4\sqrt{16-x^2}\,dx$।\\ধরি, $x=4\sin\theta$; $\therefore dx=4\cos\theta d\theta$। সীমা: $x=0$ হলে $\theta=0$ এবং $x=4$ হলে $\theta=\frac{\pi}{2}$।\\$=4\int_0^{\pi/2}\sqrt{16-16\sin^2\theta}\cdot4\cos\theta d\theta$\\$=64\int_0^{\pi/2}\cos^2\theta d\theta=32\int_0^{\pi/2}2\cos^2\theta d\theta$\\$=32\int_0^{\pi/2}(1+\cos2\theta)d\theta=32\left[\theta+\frac{1}{2}\sin2\theta\right]_0^{\pi/2}=16\pi$ বর্গ একক। (Ans.)

Question: $x^2+y^2=16$ বৃত্তের ১ম চতুর্ভাগে আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর।
DetailedAnswer: (b) যেহেতু সম্পূর্ণ বৃত্তের ক্ষেত্রফল $16\pi$ বর্গ একক, সুতরাং ১ম চতুর্ভাগে আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রফল $=\frac{1}{4}\times16\pi=4\pi$ বর্গ একক। (Ans.)

Question: $x^2+y^2=16$ বৃত্তের $x$-অক্ষের উপরের অংশের ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর।
DetailedAnswer: (c) যেহেতু বৃত্তটির কেন্দ্র মূলবিন্দু, সুতরাং $x$-অক্ষের উপরের অর্ধবৃত্তের ক্ষেত্রফল $=\frac{1}{2}\times16\pi=8\pi$ বর্গ একক। (Ans.)

Question: $x=5\cos\theta$ ও $y=5\sin\theta$ দ্বারা প্রকাশিত বৃত্ত অথবা $x^2+y^2=25$ বৃত্ত এবং $x=3$ সরলরেখা দ্বারা আবদ্ধ ক্ষুদ্রতম ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর।
DetailedAnswer: (iii) $x=5\cos\theta$ ও $y=5\sin\theta$ হলে $x^2+y^2=25$ এবং $y=\pm\sqrt{25-x^2}$।\\চিত্র হতে, নির্ণেয় ক্ষেত্রফল $=2\int_3^5\sqrt{25-x^2}dx$।\\$x=5\sin\theta$ হলে, $dx=5\cos\theta d\theta$ এবং $\sqrt{25-x^2}=5\cos\theta$। সীমা: $x=3$ হলে $\theta=\sin^{-1}\frac{3}{5}$ এবং $x=5$ হলে $\theta=\frac{\pi}{2}$।\\$\therefore$ নির্ণেয় ক্ষেত্রফল $=2\int_{\sin^{-1}(3/5)}^{\pi/2}25\cos^2\theta d\theta$\\$=25\int_{\sin^{-1}(3/5)}^{\pi/2}(1+\cos2\theta)d\theta$\\$=25\left[\theta+\frac{1}{2}\sin2\theta\right]_{\sin^{-1}(3/5)}^{\pi/2}$\\$=25\left[\frac{\pi}{2}-\sin^{-1}\frac{3}{5}-\frac{1}{2}\sin\left(2\sin^{-1}\frac{3}{5}\right)\right]$\\$=25\left[\frac{\pi}{2}-\sin^{-1}\frac{3}{5}-\frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{24}{25}\right]=\frac{25\pi}{2}-25\sin^{-1}\frac{3}{5}-12$ বর্গ একক। (Ans.)

Question: $x^2+y^2=64$ এবং $y=5$ সরলরেখা দ্বারা আবদ্ধ ক্ষুদ্রতম অংশের ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর।
DetailedAnswer: (iv) দেওয়া আছে, বৃত্তের সমীকরণ $x^2+y^2=64$, বা $x=\sqrt{64-y^2}$ এবং সরলরেখার সমীকরণ $y=5$। বৃত্তটির ব্যাসার্ধ $8$ একক।\\বৃত্তচাপ ও রেখা দ্বারা $x$-অক্ষের উপরে আবদ্ধ ক্ষুদ্রাংশের ক্ষেত্রফল $=2\int_5^8\sqrt{64-y^2}dy$\\$=2\left[\frac{y\sqrt{8^2-y^2}}{2}+\frac{8^2}{2}\sin^{-1}\frac{y}{8}\right]_5^8$\\$=2\left[16\pi-\frac{5\sqrt{39}}{2}-32\sin^{-1}\frac{5}{8}\right]$\\$=32\pi-5\sqrt{39}-64\sin^{-1}\frac{5}{8}$ বর্গ একক। (Ans.)

Question: $y^2=4x$ পরাবোলা এবং $y=x$ সরলরেখা দ্বারা আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর।
DetailedAnswer: 3.(i) প্রদত্ত পরাবৃত্তের সমীকরণ, $y^2=4x$ এবং সরলরেখার সমীকরণ $y=x$।\\দুটি রেখার ছেদবিন্দু নির্ণয়ে $x^2=4x$ বা, $x(x-4)=0$; $\therefore x=0,4$।\\নির্ণেয় ক্ষেত্রফল $=\int_0^4(y_1-y_2)dx=\int_0^4(2\sqrt{x}-x)dx$\\$=\left[\frac{4}{3}x^{3/2}-\frac{x^2}{2}\right]_0^4=\frac{32}{3}-8=\frac{8}{3}$ বর্গ একক। (Ans.)

Question: $y^2=4x$ পরাবোলা এবং $x=2y$ সরলরেখা দ্বারা আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর।
DetailedAnswer: (ii) $y^2=4x$ এবং $x=2y$ সরলরেখা। সরলরেখার সমীকরণকে পরাবোলায় বসিয়ে পাই, $y^2=8y$ বা, $y(y-8)=0$; $\therefore y=0,8$। ছেদবিন্দুদ্বয় $(0,0)$ ও $(16,8)$।\\নির্ণেয় ক্ষেত্রফল $=\int_0^{16}(y_1-y_2)dx=\int_0^{16}\left(2\sqrt{x}-\frac{x}{2}\right)dx$\\$=\left[\frac{4}{3}x^{3/2}-\frac{1}{4}x^2\right]_0^{16}=\frac{4}{3}(64)-\frac{1}{4}(256)=\frac{64}{3}$ বর্গ একক। (Ans.)

Question: $y=4x-x^2$ পরাবৃত্ত ও $x$-অক্ষ দ্বারা আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর।
DetailedAnswer: (iii) $x$-অক্ষের সমীকরণ $y=0$। পরাবৃত্তের সাথে ছেদবিন্দু পেতে, $0=4x-x^2$ বা, $x(4-x)=0$; $\therefore x=0,4$।\\পরাবৃত্তের সাথে $x$-অক্ষের ছেদবিন্দুদ্বয় $(0,0)$ ও $A(4,0)$।\\$\therefore$ ক্ষেত্রফল $=\int_0^4ydx=\int_0^4(4x-x^2)dx$\\$=\left[2x^2-\frac{x^3}{3}\right]_0^4=32-\frac{64}{3}=\frac{32}{3}$ বর্গ একক। (Ans.)

Question: $x-y+2=0$ সরলরেখা এবং $y=x^2$ পরাবৃত্ত দ্বারা আবদ্ধ বক্রতলের ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর।
